4Z2UegYSL2.problem: Query-guided token pruning keeps enough evidence for multiple-choice answers but discards details needed for long-form open-ended generation, and retained representations carry needless numerical precision.
4Z2UegYSL2.method: Structure-Aware Token Consolidation merges redundant representations using spatiotemporal similarity in video and local continuity in audio. Semantic-Sensitivity Guided Precision Allocation then assigns value precision to retained representations according to an estimated sensitivity measure (abstract truncated).
4Z2UegYSL2.key_idea: Consolidate structurally redundant tokens, then assign KV value precision per token according to estimated semantic sensitivity.
4Z2UegYSL2.evidence: Not stated in the available abstract; the TL;DR says generation quality is preserved for long-form omni-modal generation.

UAuQvym5ta.one_liner: Integral-Derivative load controller for MoE routing that scales corrections with load error and reacts to worsening imbalance.
UAuQvym5ta.problem: With extremely sparse routing, expert load imbalance reduces parameter utilization and training efficiency and undermines training stability.
UAuQvym5ta.method: Interprets DeepSeek's loss-free method as a fixed-step integral controller and Kimi K3's Quantile Balancing as a generalized proportional controller. ID Balancing scales its integral term with load error and activates its derivative term only when imbalance worsens.
UAuQvym5ta.key_idea: An integral term scaled by load error plus a derivative term gated on worsening imbalance, for auxiliary-loss-free expert balancing.
UAuQvym5ta.evidence: Top-10, Top-5 and Top-3 routing over 768 experts, and parameter scaling from 18.9B to 69.9B at Top-10-of-768.
UAuQvym5ta.claimed_gains: Reduces worst-case backbone MaxVio and training-average backbone MinVio by over 50% and 12% respectively versus the best baselines in the Top-3 setting, with worst-case MaxVio nearly unchanged from 18.9B to 69.9B parameters.

FVfI9jvpjF.one_liner: Derives max-information bounds for approximate and Renyi differential privacy, enabling non-vacuous PAC-Bayes bounds with a DP-SGD-learned prior.
FVfI9jvpjF.problem: The relationship between generalization and privacy remains poorly understood, especially for deep networks trained with DP-SGD variants.
FVfI9jvpjF.method: Proves explicit upper bounds on approximate max-information for any (epsilon, delta)-DP or Renyi-DP algorithm, then stronger guarantees for Gaussian output perturbation and streaming DP-SGD by exploiting their internal randomization. Applies the results to PAC-Bayes bounds whose prior is learned by DP-SGD.
FVfI9jvpjF.key_idea: Bound approximate max-information through DP guarantees and exploit the internal randomization of Gaussian output perturbation and streaming DP-SGD for tighter bounds.
FVfI9jvpjF.evidence: Theoretical derivations; the application yields non-vacuous PAC-Bayes generalization bounds for deep networks, with datasets not stated.

2Yi1km4MeS.one_liner: World action model that co-denoises future RGB latents, compact 3D geometric latents and actions for manipulation.
2Yi1km4MeS.problem: Existing World Action Models work in appearance-oriented video latent spaces and lack the 3D spatial understanding needed for precise manipulation.
2Yi1km4MeS.method: GeoAct jointly models future RGB latents and geometric latents, where GeoAE compresses multi-layer VGGT-Omega features into a low-dimensional spatiotemporal latent through feature reconstruction and explicit 3D geometric decoding. Training co-denoises RGB, geometry and actions, while deployment infers actions from RGB without online geometry encoding.
2Yi1km4MeS.key_idea: Predict compressed 3D geometric latents alongside RGB latents during training, then drop geometry encoding at deployment.
2Yi1km4MeS.evidence: Evaluations on LIBERO-Plus and a second benchmark whose name is cut off in the available abstract.
2Yi1km4MeS.claimed_gains: Mean success rates of 84.6% on LIBERO-Plus and 92.6% on a second benchmark whose name is cut off.

Rzb1DDbMI3.one_liner: Proves Muon-style normalized singular-value maps can anti-align with the gradient and derives a safe momentum and batch-size zone.
Rzb1DDbMI3.problem: Muon divides momentum by its Frobenius norm and applies a polynomial to singular values, and it is unclear when this update, averaged over minibatch noise, can turn against the loss gradient.
Rzb1DDbMI3.method: Proves that for sign-symmetric noise, staying gradient-aligned on every task is equivalent to monotonicity of the update map, and that smooth nonlinear maps of normalized singular values break monotonicity once the matrix has three singular values. It then analyzes how the shared norm couples singular values over single and multiple steps.
Rzb1DDbMI3.key_idea: The shared Frobenius norm couples singular values, so nonlinear singular-value maps lose monotonicity, and the harm persists only with light momentum and tiny batches.
Rzb1DDbMI3.evidence: Proofs plus GPT-2-small training and a least-squares stress test.
Rzb1DDbMI3.claimed_gains: Safe zone of Muon's default momentum at any batch size, or lighter momentum down to 0.3 with minibatches of eight or more samples.

7ZHjLcj92U.one_liner: Image-to-video human visual effects generation using identity-preserving SFT, anatomical-reward RL, and VQA-guided noise optimization.
7ZHjLcj92U.problem: Visual effects on people must preserve facial identity, body structure and motion continuity, and multi-person scenes need accurate effect assignment despite scarce multi-person effect data.
7ZHjLcj92U.method: Three stages: SFT with a dedicated face-reference branch; RL with anatomical and motion rewards plus supervised regularization; and VLM-guided test-time optimization where a differentiable VQA reward updates the initial noise.
7ZHjLcj92U.key_idea: Update the initial noise at test time with a differentiable VLM VQA reward to refine effect assignment and interaction for multiple people.
7ZHjLcj92U.evidence: Experiments reported on identity preservation, human motion, effect alignment and user preference; datasets are not stated.

NevpqvduAX.one_liner: Scala 3 library on JAX encoding tensor dimension names as static types to catch shape errors at compile time.
NevpqvduAX.problem: Numerical and ML libraries represent all multidimensional data with generic tensor types, forgoing the comprehension and verification benefits of static typing.
NevpqvduAX.method: DimWit encodes programmer-defined dimension names, such as Batch and Feature, as types in tensor types like Tensor2[Batch, Feature, Float32] and tracks them across operations, using JAX as the computational engine.
NevpqvduAX.key_idea: Dimension names are programmer-defined static types, so the Scala 3 compiler checks axis and shape consistency across tensor operations.
NevpqvduAX.evidence: Applications from linear regression to variational autoencoders, clustering and simulations, twelve reconstructed axis- and shape-related defects, and GPT-2 training throughput.
NevpqvduAX.claimed_gains: Rejects twelve selected real-world shape defects at compile time and trains GPT-2 at 97% of plain JAX throughput.

LMBxL8lKaY.one_liner: One-step generative models on compact manifolds via Sinkhorn-divergence Wasserstein gradient flows with an identifiability condition.
LMBxL8lKaY.problem: Diffusion and flow models extended to compact manifolds typically need tens or hundreds of sequential network evaluations to sample.
LMBxL8lKaY.method: RW-FLOW learns one-step generators via Wasserstein gradient flows and proves that, for a symmetric Lipschitz cost, the Sinkhorn-divergence velocity field is identifiable if and only if the Gibbs kernel is nondegenerate. This guides the design of identifiable costs and shows squared geodesic distance does not always guarantee identifiability.
LMBxL8lKaY.key_idea: The Sinkhorn velocity field is identifiable exactly when the Gibbs kernel is nondegenerate, which selects costs for which zero velocity implies matching the target.
LMBxL8lKaY.evidence: Theoretical identifiability result plus benchmarks on geospatial events and protein-related data; the abstract is truncated.

rcijc7IjDd.one_liner: Uses AlphaEvolve to discover CFR and PSRO variants, then distills them into minimal closed-form solvers.
rcijc7IjDd.problem: Progress in multi-agent RL for imperfect-information games has depended on manual, iterative refinement of algorithmic baselines.
rcijc7IjDd.method: Runs AlphaEvolve over the CFR and PSRO design spaces to produce VAD-CFR and SHOR-PSRO, then uses train-only ablation criteria to distill them into WOP-CFR and PM-PSRO.
rcijc7IjDd.key_idea: LLM-driven evolutionary code search followed by train-only ablation that strips overfitted machinery and keeps minimal cores.
rcijc7IjDd.evidence: An 18-game suite spanning Poker, Goofspiel, Liar's Dice, Blotto and Battleship variants, and ten independent search runs showing the distilled cores recur.
rcijc7IjDd.claimed_gains: Discovered algorithms are consistently competitive with the strongest human-designed baselines across an 18-game suite; no numeric gains stated.

CaJ7LEAYFp.one_liner: Generates noise-like appearance-free videos where only motion carries information, to test VLM motion perception against humans.
CaJ7LEAYFp.problem: It is unclear whether VLMs match humans at perceiving motion-defined forms in videos whose individual frames look like pure noise.
CaJ7LEAYFp.method: An algorithm generates appearance-free videos from any motion source, and AppearFreeVQA collects about 5,300 such videos across four motion categories and three difficulty levels.
CaJ7LEAYFp.key_idea: Encode content only in inter-frame motion while every individual frame stays indistinguishable from noise.
CaJ7LEAYFp.evidence: Human versus frontier VLM accuracy on the benchmark, oracle optical-flow experiments with Qwen3.5-9B, and training transfer to camouflaged object detection.
CaJ7LEAYFp.claimed_gains: Humans reach about 93% accuracy versus 41.7% for GPT-5.1, and supplying target optical flow lifts Qwen3.5-9B from 14.6% to 66.8%.

N4UzOK1Pqp.one_liner: Training-free streaming-video KV memory that scores KVs by importance plus representativeness and allocates layer budgets by group entropy.
N4UzOK1Pqp.problem: Visual KV compression treats KVs as independent units, so feature-similar redundant KVs distort layer-wise memory-demand estimates and waste retention slots.
N4UzOK1Pqp.method: RaKV defines a unified score combining query-agnostic importance with feature representativeness. For cross-layer allocation it groups feature-similar KVs and measures group-level entropy, and for within-layer retention it keeps KVs that are important and representative of distinct visual patterns.
N4UzOK1Pqp.key_idea: Group feature-similar KVs, use group-level entropy for layer demand, and rank KVs by importance combined with representativeness.
N4UzOK1Pqp.evidence: Streaming video benchmarks and MLLM backbones under a bounded visual KV budget.
N4UzOK1Pqp.claimed_gains: Gains of up to 9.50% over the original backbone under a bounded visual KV budget.

pluY5EzoJH.one_liner: Continuous depth batching re-forms batches between loop steps so tokens with different loop counts share efficient inference.
pluY5EzoJH.problem: Tokens in looped language models exit after different numbers of loops, so they cannot share a uniform forward pass in standard batching systems such as vLLM.
pluY5EzoJH.method: Continuous depth batching forms new batches between loop steps, dynamically schedules looped and non-looped parts of the architecture, manages looped KV-caching, and predicts which tokens will exit in advance to prepare batches asynchronously.
pluY5EzoJH.key_idea: Re-form batches between loop iterations using exit prediction, so per-token depth savings become wall-clock speedups.
pluY5EzoJH.evidence: Experiments on Ouro 1.4B and Huginn 3.5B, finding that fully looped architectures suit depth-adaptive inference best.
pluY5EzoJH.claimed_gains: Realizes up to 99% of the estimated maximum speedup available.

n4R542IvqC.one_liner: Rescales normalization and weight initialization to deliberately unbalance their conservation law and speed up training.
n4R542IvqC.problem: The conservation law between normalization affine parameters and downstream weights sets their relative learning speed, but initialization schemes do not control it deliberately.
n4R542IvqC.method: Shows that normalization's affine parameters have a conservation law with downstream weights, and rescales the initialization to push normalization and weight parameters further out of balance to control relative learning speeds.
n4R542IvqC.key_idea: Set the imbalance of the conservation law between normalization affine parameters and downstream weights through a rescaled initialization.
n4R542IvqC.evidence: Experiments on convolutional networks and Transformers against standard and balanced initializations.

IytBZgafMy.one_liner: Long-term agent memory that builds facets from source interactions and retrieves each representation through isolated channels.
IytBZgafMy.problem: Multiple memory representations interfere: abstraction leakage during construction and cross-facet suppression during retrieval distort which evidence is preserved and selected.
IytBZgafMy.method: PrismMem decouples semantic organization, factual construction and retrieval: abstractions delimit semantic scopes, durable-state and situated-content facets are built directly from source interactions with provenance, and each representation is retrieved through its own channel before selections are composed and linked source evidence is recovered.
IytBZgafMy.key_idea: Build facets from source interactions rather than abstractions and retrieve each representation in an isolated channel to avoid cross-representation interference.
IytBZgafMy.evidence: Five independent runs on LoCoMo, LongMemEval-S, PersonaMem-32K and BEAM-1M, plus matched controlled experiments.
IytBZgafMy.claimed_gains: Highest overall score on each of the four benchmarks among the evaluated memory systems; no numbers stated.

QhRLRlu3NB.one_liner: Autoregressive 3D-native model that tokenizes text, images and 3D in one sequence and trains with interleaved cross-modal tasks.
QhRLRlu3NB.problem: High-quality 3D assets are far scarcer than 2D images, leaving 3D synthesis under-constrained, and edit-in-2D-then-lift pipelines sacrifice geometric consistency.
QhRLRlu3NB.method: Omni123 represents text, images and 3D geometry as discrete tokens in a shared sequence space within one autoregressive framework. An interleaved X-to-X training paradigm covers heterogeneous paired datasets without needing aligned text-image-3D triplets, traversing semantic-visual-geometric cycles.
QhRLRlu3NB.key_idea: Use cross-modal generative consistency between 2D images and 3D tokens as an implicit structural constraint, so abundant 2D data fortifies 3D representations.
QhRLRlu3NB.evidence: Not stated in the available abstract text, which is truncated.

aqVMf1SyfA.one_liner: Training-free visual token pruning that revisits evidence during decoding and stops reasoning early once answers become consistent.
aqVMf1SyfA.problem: Pruning visual tokens at prefill shifts the burden to decoding, since discarded evidence triggers repeated verification and extra answer attempts that lengthen generation.
aqVMf1SyfA.method: VISTA builds a compact, diverse visual reserve at prefill, dynamically revisits relevant evidence under a fixed visual budget using attention trajectories, and terminates reasoning through periodic answer-consistency probes.
aqVMf1SyfA.key_idea: Jointly control visual evidence retention, attention-guided revisiting of evidence, and answer-consistency-based early stopping of reasoning.
aqVMf1SyfA.evidence: Three VLMs across seven multimodal benchmarks covering document understanding, visual reasoning and medical VQA under strict visual budgets.
aqVMf1SyfA.claimed_gains: Reduces average generation length by 36.3% while improving average performance by 25.4% over the strongest baseline.

vLtzlAVxpg.one_liner: Streaming multimodal language model predicting discrete word-level prosody from audio-visual context for spoken sports narration.
vLtzlAVxpg.problem: Streaming video models decide what to say but not how to say it, while text-conditioned speech models lack the perceptual context to set prosody.
vLtzlAVxpg.method: Defines the Prosodic Video Narration task, builds a sports commentary dataset with aligned video, environmental audio, text and word-level prosodic annotations, and proposes ProsodyMLM with lightweight adapters, prosody injection and a two-stage training strategy.
vLtzlAVxpg.key_idea: Autoregressively predict discrete word-level prosody from streaming audio-visual context through lightweight adapters and prosody injection.
vLtzlAVxpg.evidence: Quantitative metrics and a user study against baselines on the new sports commentary dataset.

qFBUcM4Ujz.one_liner: Black-box LLM lineage fingerprinting using rare prompt-response pairs whose behavior survives finetuning.
qFBUcM4Ujz.problem: Fingerprinting methods modify the protected model or use behavioral signatures with no explanation of why they persist under finetuning, parameter-efficient tuning and quantization.
qFBUcM4Ujz.method: RAFP searches for rare prompt-response pairs whose behaviors are shared within a lineage but discriminative against unrelated models, without modifying parameters. Theory shows likelihood drift in rare regions stays bounded under mild assumptions.
qFBUcM4Ujz.key_idea: Downstream adaptation concentrates on high-density behaviors, so low-probability prompt regions stay stable and yield persistent lineage fingerprints.
qFBUcM4Ujz.evidence: Experiments across four LLM families and multiple downstream adaptations, plus a theoretical bound on likelihood drift.

Y5LLXQoirL.one_liner: Constructs constant-depth fixed-precision softmax transformers that are doubly exponentially more succinct than finite automata.
Y5LLXQoirL.problem: Whether fixed-precision softmax transformers can be doubly exponentially more succinct than finite automata, and whether C-RASP+ admits a polynomial-size translation, were open questions.
Y5LLXQoirL.method: Constructs constant-depth causal transformers with one head per layer, no positional encodings, width and precision O(n) and description length O(n^3), whose smallest equivalent NFAs and DFAs have 2^Theta(2^n) states. Also shows C-RASP+ needs description size 2^Theta(n), and that nonemptiness is NEXP-complete.
Y5LLXQoirL.key_idea: Prefixes encode 2^(2^n) Boolean tables, which forces doubly exponential state counts in any equivalent automaton.
Y5LLXQoirL.evidence: Formal proofs of the succinctness separation, the C-RASP+ lower bound and the NEXP-completeness of nonemptiness.
Y5LLXQoirL.claimed_gains: Doubly exponential succinctness over NFAs and DFAs (2^Theta(2^n) states) with description length O(n^3), while C-RASP+ needs 2^Theta(n).

kWSi5CPmFM.one_liner: Hamiltonian network that decomposes energy into kinetic and potential parts built from shared local multi-neighborhood functions.
kWSi5CPmFM.problem: A Hamiltonian modeled by an MLP inherits spectral bias, learning smooth energy components more readily than fine-scale variations that strongly affect dynamics after differentiation.
kWSi5CPmFM.method: LM-HNN splits the energy into kinetic and potential components and represents each as a sum of shared local functions over multiple interaction neighborhoods, replacing one high-dimensional approximation with lower-dimensional reusable interaction laws.
kWSi5CPmFM.key_idea: Decompose the Hamiltonian by physical interaction structure into shared local functions over several neighborhood scales.
kWSi5CPmFM.evidence: Low-dimensional, interacting and fast-slow systems, measuring Hamiltonian derivative accuracy and long-horizon rollouts against structure-preserving models.

XeHD3R0IDz.one_liner: SE(3)-equivariant flow-matching policy with an end-effector-anchored translational source and a Haar-measure rotational source.
XeHD3R0IDz.problem: Equivariant transport alone does not yield an equivariant policy, and the commonly used isotropic Gaussian source at the world-frame origin is not translation-equivariant.
XeHD3R0IDz.method: Proves that under an invertible equivariant flow the policy inherits the source's equivariance error exactly, and characterizes compatible sources. GARLIC anchors the translational source at the end-effector, samples rotations from the normalized Haar measure, and transports with an equivariant geometric-algebra transformer.
XeHD3R0IDz.key_idea: Make the source distribution equivariant, with end-effector-anchored translation and Haar-measure rotation, because the flow cannot correct an incompatible source.
XeHD3R0IDz.evidence: RLBench experiments on task success, out-of-distribution generalization and parameter efficiency, plus transfer to real-robot manipulation.

OoSDzAVuMs.one_liner: Projects the scarce target-data update direction onto a feasible set defined by general training data.
OoSDzAVuMs.problem: LLM post-training must use scarce high-fidelity target data alongside abundant but imperfectly aligned general data, which existing methods frame as data selection.
OoSDzAVuMs.method: At each step the framework builds a feasible set of update directions from general data alone and projects the target-data update direction onto it. Standard training and data selection become special cases with different regularization strengths, and a family of methods exposes that strength as a design choice.
OoSDzAVuMs.key_idea: Treat general data as a data-induced regularizer that defines a feasible update set onto which the target-data gradient is projected.
OoSDzAVuMs.evidence: A theory tying regularization strength to how well general data covers target signals and how much target noise it admits; LLM-scale experiments are not detailed in the available abstract.

208KS043Hw.one_liner: Probe guidance builds a guidance signal from frozen internal states of a diffusion language model without an extra forward pass.
208KS043Hw.problem: Autoguidance-style guidance for diffusion models needs an additional forward pass and does not ensure the weak and strong models share similar dynamics.
208KS043Hw.method: Probe guidance trains probes on the frozen internal states of an existing diffusion model to construct the guidance signal, and is applied to continuous diffusion language models. The probes are also used to study autoguidance with a weak checkpoint.
208KS043Hw.key_idea: The weak guidance model is a probe on the frozen strong model's internal states, which removes the second network pass.
208KS043Hw.evidence: Unconditional generation benchmarks, multiple-choice QA benchmarks on a 1.7B diffusion language model, and an analysis of autoguidance with weak checkpoints.
208KS043Hw.claimed_gains: Reports the best unconditional generation results for continuous diffusion language models and consistent multiple-choice QA gains on a 1.7B model; no other numbers stated.

VeFsdb2Do6.one_liner: Benchmark and open framework comparing KV-cache reuse methods when preceding text or the model checkpoint changes.
VeFsdb2Do6.problem: Prefix caching fails when the preceding text or the model changes, and method papers use different tasks, models and cost measures, so reported results cannot be compared directly.
VeFsdb2Do6.method: KVShareArena provides reuse tests (the abstract is cut off after 2,150), a common interface and a leaderboard that compare repair and compression methods on quality and cost under the same conditions.
VeFsdb2Do6.key_idea: Evaluate KV-cache repair and compression methods under shared conditions for both changed preceding context and changed model checkpoints.
VeFsdb2Do6.evidence: Benchmark settings motivated by RAG, multi-agent workflows and cross-model transfer; results are not stated in the available abstract.

nJrDPmSlNA.one_liner: Membership inference on on-policy distillation that compares fresh student-trajectory log-probabilities against the maximum over reference models.
nJrDPmSlNA.problem: It is poorly understood whether a distilled student leaks private records supplied as privileged information to the teacher during on-policy distillation.
nJrDPmSlNA.method: LEAKY samples fresh trajectories from the target model, compares its token log-probabilities with the maximum across matched reference models trained without the candidate records, and applies Leaky ReLU to the gaps to downweight negative ones.
nJrDPmSlNA.key_idea: Score gaps between target and max-over-reference token log-probabilities on fresh trajectories, with Leaky ReLU damping negative gaps.
nJrDPmSlNA.evidence: Fifteen targets spanning mathematics, medical question answering and code generation, compared against baselines.
nJrDPmSlNA.claimed_gains: Mean AUROC 0.875 versus 0.614 for the strongest baseline on each target in the main evaluation, and 0.826 for the strongest baseline on the same sampled trajectories.

8Hw17CdlcV.one_liner: Evidence-governed recursive harness evolution for video understanding using content-free feedback and isolated probe-race branches.
8Hw17CdlcV.problem: Recursive harness evolution overfits limited, noisy, repeatedly reused validation feedback, producing validation overfitting, search-budget dilution and an early-experience trap.
8Hw17CdlcV.method: VideoHarness-BRSI first evolves harnesses around a frozen vision-language model, and analysis of over 4,000 candidates exposes the failure modes. VideoHarness-SRSI then restricts the proposer to content-free feedback, runs instrumented warm-up experiments, and develops mechanisms in isolated probe-race branches before factorial composition.
8Hw17CdlcV.key_idea: Make every search decision rest on transferable, sufficient evidence gathered before the search commits to a direction.
8Hw17CdlcV.evidence: Analysis of over 4,000 evolved candidates in agentic video understanding; final results are cut off in the available abstract.

BKNtKgmPyh.one_liner: Training-free cache policies for diffusion robot policies chosen by end-effector pose error from block-level interventions.
BKNtKgmPyh.problem: Feature similarity ignores how the remaining denoising network and robot kinematics transform approximation errors into end-effector displacement and rotation.
BKNtKgmPyh.method: Single-block interventions recompute the full network suffix, and an EE-Pose objective measures position and orientation errors. A fixed-budget compiler minimizes CVaR tail risk, conditional pair refinement handles interacting changes, and deployment runs a frozen step-layer matrix.
BKNtKgmPyh.key_idea: Allocate cache by measured task-space consequences of per-block interventions rather than feature similarity, minimizing CVaR of intervention cost.
BKNtKgmPyh.evidence: RoboTwin2 experiments with calibration needing no retraining or task-success labels; further settings are cut off in the abstract.
BKNtKgmPyh.claimed_gains: Near-full task success with 76.7% block reuse, 3.94x action-denoising and 2.83x complete-policy inference speedups on RoboTwin2, and 3.81x Action-DiT speedup per the TL;DR.

lnSodbrQix.one_liner: Co-evolves a solver agent and a grader agent by alternating tool-using updates to each.
lnSodbrQix.problem: A fixed evaluator becomes inadequate as an agent's behaviors and failure modes change, yet agent improvement needs effective evaluation feedback.
lnSodbrQix.method: DUET iteratively selects training tasks, runs the solver, grades outcomes with the grader, and uses a tool-using update module to revise the solver and the grader, alternating between them across rounds.
lnSodbrQix.key_idea: Treat the grader as an optimization target updated inside the loop, so evaluation adapts alongside the solver.
lnSodbrQix.evidence: Experiments across four agent benchmarks; results are cut off in the available abstract.

ycRvTFBx6y.one_liner: Iterative LM loop with a structured context window lets small transformers learn planning algorithms and generalize to longer horizons.
ycRvTFBx6y.problem: LLMs struggle to solve planning problems reliably even though transformers are Turing-complete, leaving a gap between theoretical power and empirical planning performance.
ycRvTFBx6y.method: Chain of Computation places a transformer LM inside an iterative loop and uses a Structured Context Window as external memory that exposes only the portion of context needed at each step, keeping input size approximately constant. The LM learns the planning policy, world model and arithmetic.
ycRvTFBx6y.key_idea: An external structured context window limits each step's input to the needed portion, so a pattern-matching LM executes planning step by step.
ycRvTFBx6y.evidence: Small LMs trained from scratch on planning problems (the abstract is truncated); keywords mention pushdown automata and depth-first search.

mEClfxTXs7.one_liner: Hyperbolic LLM using Busemann-function logits on learnable hyperbolic output embeddings with a standard Transformer backbone.
mEClfxTXs7.problem: Fully hyperbolic LLMs such as HELM add hyperbolic operations throughout the Transformer and raise cost, while evidence for hyperbolic structure concerns token embeddings and last hidden states.
mEClfxTXs7.method: LBLM keeps the standard backbone and adds learnable hyperbolic token embeddings at the output layer, scored with the Lorentz Busemann Logit that treats hidden states as boundary directions. CRAdam, a curvature-learning Riemannian Adam, trains the embeddings without repeated logarithmic and exponential maps.
mEClfxTXs7.key_idea: Score tokens with the Busemann function by treating hidden states as boundary directions, avoiding exponential mapping of hidden states into hyperbolic space.
mEClfxTXs7.evidence: Models from 0.3B to 1.4B parameters compared against a Euclidean baseline with the same recipe and against HELM.
mEClfxTXs7.claimed_gains: Mean accuracy up to 7.8% higher than the Euclidean baseline trained with the same recipe, with at most 5.0% training overhead.

FEKZZT4tmO.one_liner: Decouples error proposal from error validation to reject invalid LLM scientific solutions under a false-rejection constraint.
FEKZZT4tmO.problem: Candidate generation scales beyond expert review capacity, so verification must reject invalid solutions while rarely rejecting valid ones, to cut human workload.
FEKZZT4tmO.method: OSVerify maximizes the true-negative rate under a constraint on the false-rejection rate. An error proposer searches for errors at different granularities by hierarchical decomposition, and a validator separates substantial errors from minor or hallucinated ones.
FEKZZT4tmO.key_idea: Verifying a specific proposed error is easier than discovering one, so error proposal is separated from error validation.
FEKZZT4tmO.evidence: Competition- and research-level benchmarks compared against voting baselines under the same low false-rejection constraint.
FEKZZT4tmO.claimed_gains: Reduces human reviews of invalid solutions by 46% on average versus voting baselines at the same low FNR, and by 57% after post-training the validator.

OjV808LATw.one_liner: Generates per-skill regression tests that decide whether a self-evolving agent's skill update is committed, repaired or rolled back.
OjV808LATw.problem: Skill rewrites by self-evolving agents can silently break behaviors other tasks depend on, and aggregate safeguards leave the specific at-risk behaviors unspecified.
OjV808LATw.method: A synthesizer converts a skill's past successful and failed trajectories into a versioned suite of typed predicates (outcome, trace, negative) with severity labels. An executor checks each candidate update against the suite, and a controller commits, repairs within bounds, or rolls back, without touching policy weights.
OjV808LATw.key_idea: Versioned, executable per-skill regression predicates act as a partial contract that gates each future skill edit.
OjV808LATw.evidence: Experiments across four settings that are cut off in the abstract, with an independent audit of the five-vote LLM-judge ensemble used for semantic checks.

tEPKtV0ypd.one_liner: Single-pass backprop-free test-time adaptation that remaps activations at frozen quantizer inputs toward source calibration statistics.
tEPKtV0ypd.problem: Quantized ViTs are brittle under distribution shift because shifted activations occupy frozen quantizers' calibrated ranges differently, distorting code distributions, and existing TTA is poorly matched to quantized inference.
tEPKtV0ypd.method: QuAR recalibrates activations at the input to a frozen quantizer, mapping the test stream's running per-channel statistics back toward the source calibration, with no backpropagation and no parameter updates.
tEPKtV0ypd.key_idea: Align running per-channel activation statistics to source calibration statistics at the inputs of frozen quantizers.
tEPKtV0ypd.evidence: ImageNet-C with ViT-B at 3-, 4-, 6- and 8-bit weight/activation precision against backprop-free TTA baselines.
tEPKtV0ypd.claimed_gains: Highest mean accuracy among backprop-free TTA methods at 3-, 4-, 6- and 8-bit precision, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.28 points at 8 bits.

ScB8DeYBmy.one_liner: Runtime harness that profiles instances and orchestrates ordered tool configurations for time series reasoning.
ScB8DeYBmy.problem: LLMs struggle to abstract numerical structure from long noisy time series, and analytical tools have heterogeneous capabilities and outputs that need coordination.
ScB8DeYBmy.method: A Profiler builds a per-instance runtime state, and an Orchestrator selects ordered tool configurations under a utility balancing task coverage, question relevance, task-data capability match and cost. Procedural memory reuses configurations, and a Prober executes them and aggregates outputs into structured evidence.
ScB8DeYBmy.key_idea: Split inference into tool-based quantitative abstraction and evidence-based reasoning, with the abstraction step under explicit runtime control.
ScB8DeYBmy.evidence: Not stated in the available abstract text, which is truncated.

ByivVpHUOD.one_liner: Streaming multi-view clustering using spectral-curvature disentanglement, attribution-guided suppression and cross-view alignment calibration.
ByivVpHUOD.problem: Newly arriving views bring private variations and unreliable cross-view correspondences that corrupt the global consensus over time.
ByivVpHUOD.method: Spectral curvature decouples dominant structures from private residuals. An Attribution-Guided Suppression Module purifies residuals by quantifying feature-attribution sensitivity, and a Discrepancy-Guided Cross-view Alignment Module calibrates correspondences via permutation-induced prediction inconsistency.
ByivVpHUOD.key_idea: Use spectral curvature to split consensus from private residuals, then suppress by attribution sensitivity and align by permutation-induced prediction inconsistency.
ByivVpHUOD.evidence: Experiments on benchmark datasets (not named) comparing against other methods under continuous view arrivals.

P5zViilGZ6.one_liner: Pose-indexed store of cached visual features with goal-conditioned retrieval and KV-prefix reuse for iterative navigation.
P5zViilGZ6.problem: VLM navigation agents discard computed visual features at each step, losing observations as the context fills and wasting computation across consecutive goals in the same scene.
P5zViilGZ6.method: LociNav keeps a pose-indexed feature store organized by spatial landmarks and viewing direction. For each new goal, a scoring model selects relevant stored observations and assembles a compact memory block that is prepended to the input and arranged to maximize KV prefix reuse.
P5zViilGZ6.key_idea: Index cached visual features by pose and landmark, then retrieve goal-relevant ones into a memory block arranged for KV prefix reuse.
P5zViilGZ6.evidence: A new iterative object-goal benchmark built from HM3D ObjectNav and HM3D-OVON tours, plus the natively iterative GOAT-Bench.

ebfjkdhvk4.one_liner: Future Discrepancy distillation supervises a student's state update by teacher-student discrepancy after propagating with a frozen teacher.
ebfjkdhvk4.problem: Local prediction-matching distillation ignores how discrepancies evolve during subsequent sampling, and states built by noising real data differ from the recursively generated states seen at generation time.
ebfjkdhvk4.method: From a common state the teacher and student each perform one update, and both next states are propagated with the same frozen teacher. Their discrepancy at a selected future position supervises the student's current state update, applicable to teacher- or student-rollout states.
ebfjkdhvk4.key_idea: Supervise the student by the discrepancy of states propagated forward through a frozen teacher instead of by immediate prediction matching.
ebfjkdhvk4.evidence: Comparison of teacher- and student-rollout states across teacher-student configurations; benchmarks and results are cut off in the available abstract.

iHej9De1qL.one_liner: Distills audiovisual emotion cues into EEG-native spatial and temporal supervision during training; EEG-only at inference.
iHej9De1qL.problem: EEG emotion recognition lags audiovisual systems because of low signal-to-noise ratio and strong inter-subject variability, while audio and video cannot be collected from privacy-sensitive patients.
iHej9De1qL.method: EXIST uses video and audio only as training-time supervision for EEG and discards them at inference. Cortical Dependency Distillation (CDD) transfers emotion-relevant cortical dependency priors inferred from audiovisual context into EEG spatial reasoning, and Emotional Dynamics Distillation (EDD) learns emotionally salient temporal dynamics.
iHej9De1qL.key_idea: Audiovisual signals act as structural supervision inside the EEG manifold (cortical dependencies and temporal dynamics), so transfer is EEG-to-EEG rather than cross-modal feature or logit alignment.
iHej9De1qL.evidence: The visible abstract is cut off before any experiments; no datasets, models, or settings are stated.

18EiIN9TJo.one_liner: Rounds continuous MDP policy updates to sparse binary state-level updates with Bellman-based certificates bounding return loss.
18EiIN9TJo.problem: Policy optimization yields diffuse or randomized updates, but deployment may allow changes to only a few complete state-level decisions, and it is unclear how to sparsify an update while provably controlling the loss in return.
18EiIN9TJo.method: Fractional row mixtures are treated as policies of one auxiliary two-action MDP, and extremal Bellman value functions over it give uniform first- and second-order sensitivity bounds, a rounding certificate that needs only 2d+2 Bellman solves. A sharper pre-rounding bound uses the candidate's fractional support and rounding geometry without extra Bellman solves.
18EiIN9TJo.key_idea: All fractional row mixtures are policies of a single auxiliary two-action MDP, whose extremal Bellman value functions yield uniform sensitivity bounds that certify the rounding.
18EiIN9TJo.evidence: Theory (linear dependence on the number of editable rows is unavoidable for curvature-based guarantees; exact exchange curvature is computationally intractable) plus experiments on a structured suite with genuinely fractional candidates and validated outward-rounded arithmetic.
18EiIN9TJo.claimed_gains: On a structured suite with genuinely fractional candidates, the sharper bound raises the fraction of deployments certified to improve over the baseline from 48.2% to 74.1%.

P5rH8Qk73Y.one_liner: Self-evolving multi-agent orchestration trained with transition-level process credit from state-change comparison and LLM-extracted checklist evidence.
P5rH8Qk73Y.problem: A task- or trajectory-level outcome cannot separate useful, redundant, and harmful agent transitions, and a state change alone does not show meaningful progress because repetition or unsupported reasoning also alters the state.
P5rH8Qk73Y.method: ProcEvo compares task states before and after each agent invocation to estimate its local effect, then has an external LLM extract evidence for a task-specific checklist and assess it by relevance, consistency, support, and advancement. The resulting process evidence becomes transition-level process credit that is combined with terminal supervision to optimize the learnable orchestrator.
P5rH8Qk73Y.key_idea: Verified process evidence per agent transition (state difference plus checklist evidence judged by relevance, consistency, support, advancement) becomes transition-level credit alongside terminal reward.
P5rH8Qk73Y.evidence: Evaluated on subsets of MMLU-Pro, GSM-Hard, and GPQA; the abstract is cut off before the results.

vbNDNIOuqf.one_liner: Federated graph learning where clients calibrate local semantic and structural manifolds to server-built shared references instead of identical representations.
vbNDNIOuqf.problem: Existing graph federated learning aligns prototypes and spectral characteristics between clients and server, which implicitly forces identical local representations and compresses each client's personalized representation space.
vbNDNIOuqf.method: FedGMC adds a dual manifold calibration mechanism in which each client builds client-specific correspondences with globally shared semantic and structural references. For semantics, the server constructs a geometrically optimal semantic manifold from equidistant semantic anchors to guide calibration of local semantic manifolds; the structural part is cut off in the abstract.
vbNDNIOuqf.key_idea: Server-side equidistant semantic anchors define a shared semantic manifold that each client calibrates against through client-specific correspondences, rather than enforcing identical local representations.
vbNDNIOuqf.evidence: The visible abstract is cut off before any experiments; no datasets or settings are stated.

ZPw64RYvke.one_liner: Scores 3D anomalies from four multiscale screened-Poisson responses of surface discrepancies under one shared Gaussian potential.
ZPw64RYvke.problem: Two geometric deviations of equal magnitude can carry different evidence of a defect, so reliable 3D anomaly detection must weigh the spatial pattern of a deviation against normal-shape variation, not only its size.
ZPw64RYvke.method: Signed query-to-surface discrepancies on a nominal surface are lifted into a scalar field, and screened-Poisson equilibria at increasing spatial coupling give a four-channel, exactly additive decomposition. A single geometry-conditioned Gaussian potential, shared across categories and trained only on normal scans, scores anomalies as the energy gap from the expected normal response.
ZPw64RYvke.key_idea: Decompose the discrepancy field into four exactly additive screened-Poisson responses across scales, then score the energy gap under a shared Gaussian potential that penalizes directions with little normal variation.
ZPw64RYvke.evidence: Real3D-AD and Anomaly-ShapeNet, using one shared model per dataset and comparing against unified and category-specific baselines.
ZPw64RYvke.claimed_gains: Point-level AUROC of 92.7% on Real3D-AD and 97.2% on Anomaly-ShapeNet (the margin over the previous best is cut off in the abstract).

fRrdB5HcXt.one_liner: Re-ranks text-to-aerial-person retrieval with norm-bounded feature calibration and reciprocal-neighborhood score corrections within fixed rank intervals.
fRrdB5HcXt.problem: Aerial viewing angle, altitude, and occlusion obscure the appearance cues in the text query, and scoring each gallery image independently does not use context from other gallery images.
fRrdB5HcXt.method: Bounded Feature Calibration learns a norm-constrained residual transformation by contrasting the highest-scoring positive and negative gallery images per text query, and Reciprocal Contextual Ranking builds context vectors from reciprocal neighborhoods to learn bounded score corrections among the initial top five and to rank the remaining candidates within fixed intervals. Auxiliary Description Supervision is added to strengthen supervision for aerial appearance (details cut off).
fRrdB5HcXt.key_idea: Bound each feature correction and score correction, and use reciprocal gallery neighborhoods as context to re-rank candidates within fixed intervals.
fRrdB5HcXt.evidence: The visible abstract is cut off before any experiments; no datasets or settings are stated.

hQ55TJSvsf.one_liner: Training-free context attribution that prefills once and masks only target-to-context attention, replacing repeated suffix reconstruction.
hQ55TJSvsf.problem: Perturbation-based context attribution on long contexts needs physical deletion of blocks, which forces repeated and expensive suffix reconstruction even with prefix caching.
hQ55TJSvsf.method: TraceAttention prefills once and reuses the full-context state, masking only target-to-context attention for each mask, so it keeps the mask-to-score interface of existing attribution estimators. Dual TraceAttention (DualTA) cuts the extra cost of scoring full reasoning plus answer in reasoning LLMs by selecting answer-relevant reasoning segments for a compact target.
hQ55TJSvsf.key_idea: Replace physical deletion with attention masking from target tokens to context over a cached full-context state, so each mask needs only target-side replay.
hQ55TJSvsf.evidence: 15 model-context settings, checked against held-out physical deletions using the linear datamodeling score (LDS) and Top-5 removal utility, including Qwen3.5-27B at a mean context length of 205K tokens.
hQ55TJSvsf.claimed_gains: Geometric-mean incremental speedups of 9.6x (TraceAttention) and 14.2x (DualTA) over prefix-cached deletion while retaining over 90% of the deletion reference on average for LDS and Top-5 removal utility; on Qwen3.5-27B, DualTA reduces incremental attribution latency from 841.0 (the rest is cut off).

DthGr5uRaR.one_liner: Predicts adsorbate density fields in nanoporous materials via cDFT-then-GCMC multi-fidelity training; integrating the field gives gas uptake.
DthGr5uRaR.problem: GCMC and cDFT simulations of adsorption equilibrium have a speed-accuracy tradeoff that is insufficient for high-throughput screening of nanoporous materials.
DthGr5uRaR.method: MADField reframes adsorption prediction as equilibrium density-field estimation, learning from broad, scalable cDFT density supervision together with GCMC density labels, and recovers gas uptake by integrating the predicted density field. The predicted fields also accelerate cDFT solvers.
DthGr5uRaR.key_idea: Learn the adsorbate density field with cDFT pre-training and GCMC labels, then read out uptake by integrating the predicted field.
DthGr5uRaR.evidence: Uptake accuracy against baselines for cDFT and GCMC targets, cDFT solver acceleration, label-efficiency tests with 10% of GCMC labels, and CH4 working-capacity and low-pressure CO2 screening scenarios.
DthGr5uRaR.claimed_gains: Uptake accuracy improves over the strongest baselines by 5.7x for cDFT and 3.35x for GCMC; cDFT walltime falls 5.7x while recovering 37.78% of cases that fail under standard settings; cDFT pre-training cuts GCMC uptake MAE by 41.0% with 10% of GCMC labels and by 7.2% with all labels; the number of GCMC candidate evaluations needed for the top 0.1% pool drops by 8.0 and 11.5 (unit cut off in the abstract; the TL;DR says 8-11.5x fewer).

mTkfFRmA7i.one_liner: Private RAG retrieval that prunes candidates with private keyword gating, then securely fuses reused lexical matches with semantic similarity.
mTkfFRmA7i.problem: Existing private RAG systems either incur prohibitive cryptographic overhead for strict privacy or give up substantial confidentiality to be practical.
mTkfFRmA7i.method: GateRAG applies private keyword gating to prune the search space before expensive secure computation, then reuses the keyword matches as lexical relevance signals and securely fuses them with semantic similarity over the reduced candidate set. A single parameter P sets the quality-efficiency operating point.
mTkfFRmA7i.key_idea: Private keyword gating shrinks the candidate set before secure computation, and its matches are reused as lexical signals in hybrid semantic-lexical fusion.
mTkfFRmA7i.evidence: Experiments on PubMedQA, HotpotQA, and FEVER comparing the retrieval quality-efficiency tradeoff against prior private RAG systems.

ZnAAI3cg7p.one_liner: Stabilizes on-policy distillation into block diffusion LMs with large blocks via boundary-aware step filtering and support-rebalanced confidence calibration.
ZnAAI3cg7p.problem: On-policy distillation into block diffusion language models with larger blocks is unstable because mismatched teacher and student block boundaries misalign context, and an intrinsic optimization bias drives weaker students into overconfidence collapse.
ZnAAI3cg7p.method: Un-OPD uses boundary-aware step filtering to remove context-misaligned decoding steps, and a support-rebalanced confidence calibration that moderates optimization intensity at high-support positions.
ZnAAI3cg7p.key_idea: Drop decoding steps whose teacher and student block boundaries are misaligned, and damp optimization at high-support positions so the student does not rush into overconfidence.
ZnAAI3cg7p.evidence: The visible abstract is cut off before any experiments; no datasets, models, or settings are stated.

5BlLPhRVPv.one_liner: Fits compute-optimal model-size and token-count scaling laws for native vision-language pre-training from scratch across data mixtures.
5BlLPhRVPv.problem: The scaling properties of native multimodal pre-training, including the optimal model size and token count under a fixed compute budget, are incompletely characterized.
5BlLPhRVPv.method: The authors study how to split a fixed compute budget between model size and tokens for a Transformer-based vision-language model trained from scratch, fitting loss and allocation laws across data mixtures with two estimators. The analysis also yields a budget-compensation rule relating pure-text loss to multimodal tokens.
5BlLPhRVPv.key_idea: Fit power-law compute-optimal allocations of model size and tokens separately for language and multimodal objectives across data mixtures, and derive a compute-compensation rule from the fits.
5BlLPhRVPv.evidence: A scaling study of a Transformer-based vision-language model across multiple data mixtures with two estimators and control runs; the abstract is cut off before the end.

UQiulanGmL.one_liner: Benchmark of 102 live-AWS cases testing whether cloud-management agents resolve conflicts from concurrent participants.
UQiulanGmL.problem: Existing evaluations of cloud-management agents focus on static plans or isolated execution, leaving coordination with other actors in shared cloud infrastructure untested.
UQiulanGmL.method: CloudGym has 102 cases spanning 19 AWS services and 65 resource types, each adding controlled concurrent participants whose actions create incompatible requirements, ambiguous targets, or temporary execution conflicts. Semantic oracles check initial and final cloud states plus the record of completed participant operations against the task intent under a specified resolution policy, and an automated pipeline generates the cases from existing management tasks.
UQiulanGmL.key_idea: Inject scripted concurrent participants into live AWS tasks and grade outcomes with semantic oracles over initial and final state and participant operation records under a stated resolution policy.
UQiulanGmL.evidence: Cases are certified through 2,660 test fixtures, live execution against AWS, and human quality audits; frontier agents are evaluated on the benchmark.
UQiulanGmL.claimed_gains: not stated (the top model's overall pass rate is cut off in the abstract)

tQuX3vHnVe.one_liner: Two active-learning algorithms for preference labeling, one with instance-dependent label complexity guarantees and one simple greedy method.
tQuX3vHnVe.problem: Classical experimental-design criteria such as G- or D-optimality, used to actively collect preference labels for LLM alignment, are not tailored to the structure of preference learning.
tQuX3vHnVe.method: The authors identify an intuition specific to preference learning that questions G- and D-optimal designs, and propose two algorithms: one with an instance-dependent label complexity guarantee, and a simple, practical greedy method.
tQuX3vHnVe.key_idea: Replace generic G-/D-optimal design with query selection built on preference-learning structure; the abstract does not state the exact selection rule.
tQuX3vHnVe.evidence: An instance-dependent label complexity guarantee for the first algorithm, and evaluation on real-world preference datasets.

zu2WuvyyeI.one_liner: Defines conditional expert gain for multi-expert long-tailed recognition and enforces one class-to-frequency assignment in auxiliary objectives (FSAL).
zu2WuvyyeI.problem: Standalone accuracy cannot show whether an added expert in a multi-expert long-tailed model repeats existing coverage or recovers residual errors.
zu2WuvyyeI.method: They define conditional expert gain (correctness contributed beyond the existing expert set) and show with class-frequency correspondence interventions that reversing the class-to-frequency assignment raises standalone accuracy while sharply reducing conditional gain. Frequency-Structured Auxiliary Learning (FSAL) uses a shared correspondence to orient frequency-dependent auxiliary scores within the inherited two-stage structure and expert budget.
zu2WuvyyeI.key_idea: Enforce a single class-wise frequency assignment across the auxiliary objective, orienting frequency-dependent auxiliary scores within the existing two-stage, fixed-budget expert structure.
zu2WuvyyeI.evidence: Controlled correspondence interventions, class-accuracy-preserving analysis, and experiments on CIFAR-100-LT; the rest of the results are cut off.

WGFgksL7DY.one_liner: Defers KV-cache eviction until after drafting the answer's opening tokens on the full cache, then evicts.
WGFgksL7DY.problem: Training-free KV-cache compression such as SnapKV, H2O, and PyramidKV evicts at the end of prefill, before the queries that matter exist, so attention-mass compensation and selection objectives do not translate into task quality.
WGFgksL7DY.method: Draft-Guided Eviction (DGE) decodes the answer's opening on the full cache (the first k=16 decoded tokens in the abstract; the TL;DR says the first two) and then evicts, so nothing is discarded and the cache budget is unchanged. It drops into SnapKV, PyramidKV, H2O, and StreamingLLM.
WGFgksL7DY.key_idea: Move when eviction fires rather than how tokens are scored: decode the first answer tokens on the full cache, then evict, anchoring the generation trajectory.
WGFgksL7DY.evidence: Six instruct backbones from 3B to 14B, scored on LongBench at several budgets against prior methods, with a timing-only control (DGE-W).
WGFgksL7DY.claimed_gains: Averages 42.8 on LongBench versus 39.8 for the strongest prior method and 35.3 for SnapKV (uncompressed FullKV is 44.3), with time-to-first-token within 8% of SnapKV's; the timing-only control DGE-W reaches 42.4.

rSmF1Rm9sr.one_liner: Replicates hot KV blocks across serving instances, balancing KV cache access pressure to reduce time-to-first-token.
rSmF1Rm9sr.problem: In multi-instance LLM serving, request scheduling cannot resolve the conflict between KV cache reuse and load balancing because hot KV cache couples reuse benefits with instance load.
rSmF1Rm9sr.method: KVFlow manages the KV cache directly by replicating hot KV blocks across instances. It defines KV cache access pressure to model block-access demand and balances it across instances, which the authors show minimizes peak modeled demand under uniform replica sharing.
rSmF1Rm9sr.key_idea: Replicate hot KV blocks across instances so modeled KV cache access pressure is balanced, decoupling cache reuse from load concentration.
rSmF1Rm9sr.evidence: Multiple LLMs and real LLM serving workloads compared with vLLM, Dynamo, and LMetric, plus a modeling analysis of access pressure.
rSmF1Rm9sr.claimed_gains: Reduces average time-to-first-token (TTFT) by 12.5%-54.3% compared with state-of-the-art production systems including vLLM, Dynamo, and LMetric.

QORmIdG82Z.one_liner: Critic-free hierarchical RL for multi-session agent trajectories, using session-usage signals and per-session marginal-contribution advantages.
QORmIdG82Z.problem: Agentic RL methods assume single-session trajectories, but context compaction and subagent forking produce multi-session trajectories, and broadcasting trajectory-level advantages to all sessions ignores each session's contribution and session allocation.
QORmIdG82Z.method: Mosaic is a critic-free hierarchical optimization: at the trajectory level it adds session-usage signals to advantage estimation, and at the session level it shapes each session's advantage according to its estimated marginal contribution.
QORmIdG82Z.key_idea: Replace broadcast trajectory-level advantages with session-usage-aware trajectory advantages plus session-level advantages shaped by estimated marginal contribution.
QORmIdG82Z.evidence: BrowseComp experiments with Qwen3.5-4B in context-compaction and subagent-forking scenarios, with further analyses of session utility and allocation.
QORmIdG82Z.claimed_gains: not stated (only qualitative: outperforms broadcasting in both scenarios while using fewer sessions on average)

uOHCZmHx0z.one_liner: Adaptive timestep sampler for flow matching that shifts toward harder noise levels as the model's denoising ability improves.
uOHCZmHx0z.problem: The role of timestep sampling in flow-based generative training is poorly understood, and existing methods use fixed or only weakly adaptive timestep distributions.
uOHCZmHx0z.method: The paper treats noise level as a proxy for sample difficulty, giving an easy-to-hard curriculum, and proposes CurFM, which progressively shifts the timestep distribution toward more challenging noise levels according to the model's current denoising ability.
uOHCZmHx0z.key_idea: Treat noise level as sample difficulty and adapt the timestep sampling distribution toward harder noise levels as measured denoising ability grows.
uOHCZmHx0z.evidence: A theoretical and empirical argument that noise level is a consistent difficulty measure; the abstract is cut off before the main experiments.

X1q8AF6kiW.one_liner: Robust preference optimization over a utility-gap-weighted Kendall ambiguity set with an entropy-regularized adversary over alternative rankings.
X1q8AF6kiW.problem: Preference alignment trains on fixed response orderings, but human priorities are multidimensional and context-dependent, so a policy may become misaligned when deployment priorities reorder the same responses.
X1q8AF6kiW.method: KRPO builds a Kendall ambiguity set whose cost weights ranking reversals by utility gap, so swaps between similarly scored responses cost less, and an entropy-regularized adversary emphasizes difficult but plausible alternative rankings. Because it changes only the ranking supplied to the base loss, it applies to both pairwise and listwise objectives.
X1q8AF6kiW.key_idea: Perturb the training ranking within a utility-gap-weighted Kendall ambiguity set, using an entropy-regularized adversary to pick hard but plausible alternative rankings for the base loss.
X1q8AF6kiW.evidence: Seven baseline objectives on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-1.7B, measuring cross-benchmark generalization; the abstract is cut off before the end.

RaYYqsd457.one_liner: Calibrates class-incremental MLLM predictions by scoring candidate labels and estimating class-wise corrections online with Sinkhorn matching.
RaYYqsd457.problem: In MLLM-based class-incremental learning, label-space expansion causes inference interference: persistent generative preference biases predictions toward newly introduced classes and degrades recognition of earlier ones.
RaYYqsd457.method: UnL2 derives generative evidence over the accumulated label space through Candidate Scoring, keeps a calibration queue updated with that evidence, and uses Online Calibration to estimate a class-wise correction by Sinkhorn matching for later predictions.
RaYYqsd457.key_idea: Estimate and remove a class-wise generative-preference correction from a queue of candidate-scoring evidence using Sinkhorn matching.
RaYYqsd457.evidence: Theory showing exact absorption of the shared additive class-wise preference component and bounded sensitivity of calibrated pairwise evidence, plus experiments on multiple class-incremental benchmarks.
RaYYqsd457.claimed_gains: not stated (only qualitative: consistent improvements over existing methods, with larger gains as the number of incremental tasks increases)

nzO7qaja0w.one_liner: Real-world super-resolution with a dual-scale 8x/4x latent and coarse-to-fine cascaded one-step denoising on SD-Turbo.
nzO7qaja0w.problem: The fixed 8x spatial compression of pretrained VAEs loses fine structural information in latent-diffusion super-resolution and introduces artifacts.
nzO7qaja0w.method: The HiCo-Encoder adds a parallel 4x latent branch next to the 8x representation. A cascade then uses a coarse 8x stage to set the global layout and a fine 4x stage to refine local structure, each with a single denoising step.
nzO7qaja0w.key_idea: Keep a parallel 4x latent beside the 8x latent and generate coarse-to-fine with one denoising step at each scale.
nzO7qaja0w.evidence: Three real-world super-resolution benchmarks, using only a pretrained SD-Turbo backbone.
nzO7qaja0w.claimed_gains: not stated (only qualitative: strong reconstruction fidelity and comparable perceptual quality to other diffusion-based models)

5DRukx8N4E.one_liner: Learns a state-conditioned symmetry graph whose edge reliabilities gate equivariant versus residual policy components in reinforcement learning.
5DRukx8N4E.problem: A fixed global symmetry becomes unreliable in multi-agent systems and articulated robots when dynamics, actuation constraints or interactions break symmetry selectively across entities and states.
5DRukx8N4E.method: GSPE represents candidate symmetry relations as a state-conditioned graph whose edges estimate the reliability of applying an equivariant bias between two entities. Graph-Conditioned Policy Decomposition (GCPD) splits policy computation into graph-conditioned equivariant and residual components.
5DRukx8N4E.key_idea: Estimate per-edge, per-state symmetry reliability and use it to weight an equivariant policy component against a residual component that handles broken symmetry.
5DRukx8N4E.evidence: Experiments on MuJoCo, MPE and a three-robot real-world deployment against baselines under structured symmetry violations.

TLneD1jSEr.one_liner: Standardizes logits class-wise across test samples before softmax to stop prediction collapse in test-time adaptation.
TLneD1jSEr.problem: Test-time adaptation methods often collapse so that predictions concentrate on a few classes, and the mechanism behind this failure is poorly understood.
TLneD1jSEr.method: LAST is a plug-and-play module that performs class-wise logit standardization before the softmax layer, normalizing each class's logit distribution across test samples to suppress instance-dependent logit norm fluctuations.
TLneD1jSEr.key_idea: Class-wise standardization of logits across test samples removes adaptation-induced logit norm drift that amplifies class bias in self-supervised TTA.
TLneD1jSEr.evidence: An analysis of TTA collapse dynamics links logit norm drift to prediction degeneration, and the abstract (truncated) reports experiments across multiple benchmarks.

A0yWnPOfEZ.one_liner: Streaming reconstruction using single-image metric depth as DPVO patch-depth initialization and soft constraint, plus DINOv3 adapters.
A0yWnPOfEZ.problem: Accurate camera motion estimation and dense reconstruction from long monocular videos must stay efficient over long sequences.
A0yWnPOfEZ.method: MetricTrail revisits DPVO's sparse local estimator: single-image metric depth initializes patch depths and remains as soft constraints during optimization, and learned adapters augment matching features and recurrent context with frozen DINOv3 representations. Components are trained on short clips without long-sequence training, and the depth provider can be swapped.
A0yWnPOfEZ.key_idea: Single-image metric depth initializes patch depths and stays as a soft constraint in DPVO's local optimization, without retraining the correspondence network or enlarging the window.
A0yWnPOfEZ.evidence: Trajectory error on KITTI, Oxford Spires, and VBR under RGB-only protocols, dense reconstruction on indoor and outdoor benchmarks, and in-the-wild videos.
A0yWnPOfEZ.claimed_gains: Lowest average trajectory error among evaluated methods on KITTI, Oxford Spires, and VBR under the reported RGB-only protocols; with supplied intrinsics, 12.70 FPS on KITTI-02 with 3.21 GB peak GPU memory.

nBLZ51xxGn.one_liner: A causal ledger of action-fact dependencies lets mobile GUI agents audit steps, assemble context, and curate experience by root-cause attribution.
nBLZ51xxGn.problem: Long-horizon mobile GUI agents lose earlier information in expanding context, and summarizing or retrieving past context misses silent step errors, polluting context and downstream experience distillation.
nBLZ51xxGn.method: CausGUI maintains a causal ledger logging causal dependencies across actions and observed facts, enabling online step auditing, causal-dependency context assembly, and cause-attributed experience curation. It is evaluated with MobileWorld-XL, a benchmark derived from MobileWorld for generalization of extracted experience to unseen tasks.
nBLZ51xxGn.key_idea: Logging dependencies between actions and observed facts lets delayed failures be traced to root-cause steps, so only causally verified experience is consolidated.
nBLZ51xxGn.evidence: Three public benchmarks with a Qwen3.5-397B-A17B backbone under identical conditions against competitive frameworks, plus the new MobileWorld-XL benchmark.

UwxQfl4Qsl.one_liner: Asymmetric Hybrid-Resolution Attention pools subcarrier neighbors into regional keys, and HoloRoPE scales them with learnable gains for wireless foundation models.
UwxQfl4Qsl.problem: Adjacent CSI subcarriers can lie within the coherence bandwidth and be partially redundant, and standard RoPE gives a pooled regional key a single representative position, which is limiting for position-sensitive wireless signals.
UwxQfl4Qsl.method: AHRA pools neighboring features along the subcarrier axis for a subset of heads to form regional keys and values, while queries and the remaining heads stay at native resolution. HoloRoPE scales regional keys with learnable gains based on geometric and content factors identified by comparing ways of encoding a regional key's position.
UwxQfl4Qsl.key_idea: Regional keys formed by subcarrier pooling are rescaled with learnable gains driven by geometric and content factors, instead of getting one representative RoPE position.
UwxQfl4Qsl.evidence: Experiments on large-scale wireless datasets show AHRA outperforms full-resolution attention and HoloRoPE improves on it further (abstract truncated).

yFVdLvkMVO.one_liner: DVGT-2 is a streaming driving visual geometry transformer that jointly predicts local geometry and future trajectories with cached temporal attention.
yFVdLvkMVO.problem: Multi-frame geometry reconstruction is too computationally heavy for online driving, which limits the use of dense geometric supervision in end-to-end planning.
yFVdLvkMVO.method: A Vision-Geometry-Action paradigm in which a streaming transformer jointly predicts local geometry and future trajectories, using temporal causal attention with cached historical features, a sliding-window streaming strategy and relative temporal encoding for bounded per-frame computation and memory.
yFVdLvkMVO.key_idea: Cache historical features under temporal causal attention with a sliding window and relative temporal encoding, so geometry reconstruction and planning run online at bounded cost.
yFVdLvkMVO.evidence: Local geometric accuracy on five driving datasets, planning on NAVSIM v1/v2 and nuScenes, and a latency comparison with representative VLA and WA models.

K2lBCWM238.one_liner: Tree search for ILP feasible solutions guided by learned reference values and variable ordering, trained via objective-based preference learning.
K2lBCWM238.problem: Learning-based ILP methods often rely on variable predictions that on their own do not yield high-quality, or even feasible, solutions at inference.
K2lBCWM238.method: PgTS builds on a tree search that guarantees a feasible solution and jointly learns reference values (preferred assignments) and variable ordering. Each guidance pair is run through the same tree search used at inference, and objective values give contrastive preference signals without optimal-solution labels.
K2lBCWM238.key_idea: Train guidance by running it through the inference-time tree search and contrasting guidance pairs by the objective values of the resulting feasible solutions.
K2lBCWM238.evidence: Experiments across ILP benchmarks, used both as a standalone solution generator and as a source of initial solutions for exact ILP solvers (abstract truncated).
K2lBCWM238.claimed_gains: Reports the best solution quality among compared methods and initial solutions that improve long-term solver performance; no numbers stated.

B3TYCMjqzj.one_liner: Training-free 2-bit KV cache quantization for video world models that preserves attention logits via sensitivity-aware key clustering.
B3TYCMjqzj.problem: Existing 2-bit KV cache quantizers score well on VBench yet cause temporal flickering and visual degradation, because key quantization shifts attention logits and the temporal-spatial tokens that queries select.
B3TYCMjqzj.method: QuantWM adds quantization-sensitivity-aware clustering (QSAC), which uses historical query sensitivity and residual ranges to choose INT2-friendly key centroids, plus a second complementary technique that is cut off in the abstract, to mitigate attention shifts.
B3TYCMjqzj.key_idea: Choose INT2 key centroids using historical query sensitivity and residual ranges so quantization preserves attention logits and temporal-spatial token selection.
B3TYCMjqzj.evidence: Not visible in the truncated abstract; it contrasts VBench scores with observed temporal flickering and visual degradation in video generation and world models.

OwVemZl4AT.one_liner: Learns a conditional energy landscape for generative robot control and triggers expert takeover when refinement shows energy-consistency violations.
OwVemZl4AT.problem: Long-term robot autonomy needs policies that recognize when their behavior is no longer sufficiently supported and use assistance to improve.
OwVemZl4AT.method: EqC casts generative action refinement as equilibrium-seeking optimization on an explicit conditional energy landscape, using the geometry of refinement as a competence signal. Energy-Gated DAgger triggers expert takeover on persistent violations and aggregates the recovery trajectories for later updates; it plugs into Diffusion Transformer and flow-matching VLA policies.
OwVemZl4AT.key_idea: Treat action refinement as equilibrium seeking on a learned energy landscape and use persistent energy-consistency violations as the signal to request expert help.
OwVemZl4AT.evidence: Simulation and real-world bimanual manipulation, plus a real-world study of interventions progressively expanding the situations handled autonomously.
OwVemZl4AT.claimed_gains: Matches or improves control performance and robustness while enabling timely intervention near the competence boundary; no numbers stated.

NrDYq21X8n.one_liner: Untargeted adversarial attack that starts with many competitor classes and narrows progressively to one target as evidence accumulates.
NrDYq21X8n.problem: Class-logit rankings that guide untargeted attacks change during optimization, so early target commitment or score-dependent weighting follows transient rankings toward less promising competitors.
NrDYq21X8n.method: DCD treats target selection as a coarse-to-fine process: begin with a broad candidate set, narrow it as optimization proceeds, and select a single target after sufficient evidence; DCDm repeats DCD while excluding previously selected competitors to use multiple targets.
NrDYq21X8n.key_idea: Delay committing to a competitor class, shrinking the candidate set over iterations so temporary ranking errors are not amplified.
NrDYq21X8n.evidence: Ten benchmark models and four datasets, with PGD, APGD, GAMA, FAB, and FMN under l_inf and l_2 budgets, and APGD-DCD9 applied after AutoAttack.
NrDYq21X8n.claimed_gains: Improves the base attack in 49 of 50 l_inf attack-model comparisons at equal or lower gradient budgets, and APGD-DCD9 finds 88 additional adversarial examples after AutoAttack across ten models.

VmVAE2wSyV.one_liner: Learns a temporary compiler that reshapes updates from a shared next-token loss to serve different learning ends, then removes it.
VmVAE2wSyV.problem: Models usually tie what they learn to the loss optimized in training, so they cannot easily adapt from simple, widely available objectives while serving purposes those objectives do not express.
VmVAE2wSyV.method: Heterotelic Learning is instantiated as Learned Objective Transformation (LOT), which learns a temporary compiler from supervision specifying desired behaviors or target gradients. During adaptation the compiler shapes the updates induced by a shared online objective and is then removed, leaving only the parameter changes.
VmVAE2wSyV.key_idea: A compiler learned from behavior or target-gradient supervision transforms the gradient of a shared next-token loss during adaptation, then is discarded, leaving only the parameter updates.
VmVAE2wSyV.evidence: Theoretical and empirical evidence using next-token prediction as the shared objective, evaluated on unseen contexts and multiple language-model backbones.

syOQWd2p2d.one_liner: Fits a six-parameter image warp from demonstration and four unlabeled reset images to restore frozen visuomotor policies under camera drift.
syOQWd2p2d.problem: Visuomotor policies can fail under small camera drift even when the task and action space are unchanged.
syOQWd2p2d.method: ReView matches early spatial features between stored demonstration images and four unlabeled reset images from the displaced camera to fit a six-parameter image warp. The warp corrects incoming images while the policy stays frozen, with no camera poses, depth, target actions, or rollouts.
syOQWd2p2d.key_idea: Match early spatial features between unpaired demonstration and displaced-camera images to fit an image warp applied before the frozen policy.
syOQWd2p2d.evidence: Six tasks in robomimic and ManiSkill across Diffusion Policy, ACT, SmolVLA, and pi 0.5, two real-robot tasks, and ablations on spatial correspondence.
syOQWd2p2d.claimed_gains: Improves mean success over no adaptation by 28, 22, 24, and 16 percentage points for Diffusion Policy, ACT, SmolVLA, and pi 0.5, and by 27 and 30 percentage points on two real-robot tasks.

FyHSpeJAhP.one_liner: Uses one differentiable floorplanning physics as flow-matching training loss, closed-form refiner energy, and soft cost for scoring every stage.
FyHSpeJAhP.problem: Diffusion floorplanners train on reference layouts alone, leave coupled objectives and constraints to guidance, post-hoc loops, and a legalizer, and report only endpoints, which hides what the generator contributes.
FyHSpeJAhP.method: Trinity is a flow-matching floorplanner whose six differentiable constraint and objective functions serve as a training loss term, the energy of a closed-form refiner after sampling, and the base of a soft cost at every stage. The authors also re-implement four diffusion placers under one recipe on FloorSet and score raw, refined, and legalized layouts on one scale.
FyHSpeJAhP.key_idea: Six differentiable constraint and objective functions double as flow-matching training loss, closed-form refiner energy, and a soft cost scoring raw, refined, and legalized layouts on one scale.
FyHSpeJAhP.evidence: FloorSet with four re-implemented diffusion placers, stage-by-stage scoring of raw, refined, and legalized layouts, and comparison of soft cost with the contest hard cost.
FyHSpeJAhP.claimed_gains: The training term lowers a plain transformer's raw soft cost by 26%, the shared refiner matches a ported placer's loop in 16 to 660 times fewer steps, refined soft cost is 36% below the best ported pipeline, and the pipeline reaches a mean hard cost of 1.014 in 1.63 s per case on the FloorSet val set.

VXr8euLx2W.one_liner: Format-aware task prototypes route multimodal continual instruction tuning to compatible adapters, with geometry-aware consolidation of shared knowledge.
VXr8euLx2W.problem: Image-text similarity routing in Mixture-of-LoRA-Experts sends tasks with distinct response formats but similar semantics to the same expert, causing gradient interference, for example a grounding expert biased toward short VQA answers.
VXr8euLx2W.method: ProtoAda constructs format-aware task codes that jointly capture multimodal semantics and response-protocol structure to organize the task stream for assignment and inference-time routing. It further applies geometry-aware consolidation (details truncated in the provided abstract).
VXr8euLx2W.key_idea: Route tasks by prototypes encoding both semantics and response format rather than image-text similarity alone, then consolidate adapter parameters geometry-aware.
VXr8euLx2W.evidence: Multimodal continual instruction tuning setting; benchmarks and models are not stated in the provided abstract.

Jq96CJIlB7.one_liner: Partitions prefill and decode attention between trusted client and server, permuting server key/value rows and exactly merging partial softmax states.
Jq96CJIlB7.problem: Cryptographic private inference is too costly for large-scale LLM serving, and obfuscation-based methods focus on feature transformations, leaving the sequence dimension unprotected.
Jq96CJIlB7.method: In prefill, a Trusted Client computes attention within the current block while the Server computes attention over key/value rows permuted within preceding blocks. In decode, the Client accumulates new key/value rows and permutes each completed window before uploading it to the Server cache, with exact merging preserving ordinary attention.
Jq96CJIlB7.key_idea: Obfuscate the sequence axis by permuting key/value rows within blocks on the server and exactly merging partial softmax states computed on client and server.
Jq96CJIlB7.evidence: Experiments on Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B under an evaluated prefill attack and a completed-window reconstruction attack, with WikiText-2 perplexity.
Jq96CJIlB7.claimed_gains: Under the evaluated completed-window reconstruction attack, PMA reduces ROUGE-L F1 from 0.9813-1.0000 for attention-path adaptations of STIP and AloePri to 0.2419, while keeping WikiText-2 perplexity close to ordinary inference.

N6FsjQoxGq.one_liner: Preference optimization (UDPO) with designer and user reward models refines prompts that guide a diffusion model for advertisement generation.
N6FsjQoxGq.problem: Advertisement generation methods optimize either design aesthetics or user clicks, overlooking the discrepancy between designer and user preferences: attractive ads may not engage users, and engagement-only optimization may hurt brand perception.
