N6FsjQoxGq.method: AdsPrompter takes a product image and taglines and uses User-Designer Preference Optimization (UDPO), a coarse-to-fine strategy with complementary reward models, to refine prompts that guide a diffusion-based model to generate preference-aligned ads of varying sizes. The authors also introduce a 200k-sample advertisement dataset with designer and user preferences and a benchmark.
N6FsjQoxGq.key_idea: Coarse-to-fine preference optimization combines designer-aesthetics and user-engagement reward models to train a prompt refiner placed in front of a diffusion generator.
N6FsjQoxGq.evidence: A new advertisement dataset with 200k samples and a benchmark; the experimental results are cut off in the abstract.
N6FsjQoxGq.claimed_gains: not stated; the visible abstract is cut off before the results.

69NXgYovGe.one_liner: Selects source-traceable verbalized rule evidence from irregular EHR time series with a learned selector feeding a clinical language-model encoder.
69NXgYovGe.problem: Numerical time-series models do not expose readable evidence for predictions, while text interfaces either serialize observations with limited interpretation or generate summaries that obscure links to source measurements.
69NXgYovGe.method: Multi-scale window statistics of each trajectory are verbalized as threshold-predicate rules linked to source windows, and an offline LLM attaches clinical concepts to supporting predicates or abstains. A learned Evidence Selector picks a fixed-size subset of the resulting evidence units, which a pretrained clinical language-model encoder reads to predict, with no patient-level text generation.
69NXgYovGe.key_idea: Convert windowed statistics into deterministic threshold rules tagged with LLM-assigned clinical concepts, then learn to select a fixed-size subset of these evidence units for the predictor.
69NXgYovGe.evidence: Three ICU benchmarks, where STEP-CTS is reported to outperform the evaluated text-based baselines.

TUhCCnwXZM.one_liner: Decomposes uncertainty of orchestrated LLM multi-agent systems into stepwise contributions via Tsallis entropy, then optimizes orchestration for calibration.
TUhCCnwXZM.problem: Stochastic agent interactions and system-level control create nested uncertainty that existing LLM uncertainty decomposition does not explain or calibrate in multi-agent systems.
TUhCCnwXZM.method: EcoMAS models output uncertainty with second-order Tsallis entropy and derives an exact decomposition into stepwise contributions from orchestration and agent execution, estimated by an unbiased paired sampling algorithm with finite-sample concentration bounds. It also derives an unbiased calibration gradient estimator from the semantic increments, reusing the explanation samples to optimize the orchestration policy.
TUhCCnwXZM.key_idea: Exactly decompose second-order Tsallis entropy of system output into per-step orchestration and execution contributions, and reuse the same samples to compute a calibration gradient for the orchestrator.
TUhCCnwXZM.evidence: Evaluated on MMLU-Pro, MATH-500, and ChaosNLI; comparison with exact contributions on finite execution trees shows paired sampling is accurate even at small sampling budgets, and case studies trace individual steps.

F7sG4KZOgs.one_liner: Unified benchmark aligning 56 datasets and 46 methods to test whether competence in tabular generation, imputation, and prediction transfers.
F7sG4KZOgs.problem: Tabular generation, imputation, and prediction are benchmarked separately although each is a conditional query to the same table distribution, leaving unclear whether competence on one query carries to others.
F7sG4KZOgs.method: OneTableBench preserves task-specific data, information, and evaluation contracts while aligning 56 datasets, 46 registered methods, and 20 semantic capability axes. Its four-level evidence chain audits metric redundancy and validity, measures cross-task rank alignment, estimates transfer by matched interventions over all seven non-empty combinations of the three objectives, and compares fixed models with deployable specialist portfolios.
F7sG4KZOgs.key_idea: Treat generation, imputation, and prediction as conditional queries on one table distribution and test transfer with matched interventions over all seven objective combinations.
F7sG4KZOgs.evidence: 56 datasets, 46 methods, and 20 capability axes, with Pareto and leave-one-dataset-out analyses (abstract truncated).
F7sG4KZOgs.claimed_gains: not stated (benchmark paper; the abstract reports neither universal transfer nor complete task independence, and metrics that are compressible but multidimensional).

xVDsHVTfkP.one_liner: Revisits latent memory for frozen LLM reasoners: CoT-supervised compression, intermediate-layer readout, and entropy-based recall triggering.
xVDsHVTfkP.problem: Existing latent-memory implementations rely on weakly justified defaults: a Weaver trained on brief rationales, memory read from the final layer, and recall only at punctuation boundaries.
xVDsHVTfkP.method: A What-Where-When framework: CoT-Supervised Memory Compression trains the Weaver with richer CoT supervision plus task-driven compression, Depth-Aware Readout extracts memory from intermediate layers, and the Reasoning-State-Aware Trigger fires on predictive entropy instead of punctuation.
xVDsHVTfkP.key_idea: Train memory with richer chain-of-thought supervision, read it from intermediate layers, and trigger recall when predictive entropy signals uncertainty rather than at punctuation.
xVDsHVTfkP.evidence: Evaluations across 16 configurations for CoT supervision, a layer-readout comparison, and StrategyQA for the trigger.
xVDsHVTfkP.claimed_gains: CoT supervision improves 15 of 16 evaluated configurations, intermediate-layer readout outperforms final-layer readout in 11 configurations with a macro-average gain of 4.50 percentage points, and RSAT improves StrategyQA accuracy from 63.17% to 76.13%.

2cvsJnkOoQ.one_liner: MuPACE meta-trains a small recurrent policy that adjusts the global step size of Muon during LoRA fine-tuning.
2cvsJnkOoQ.problem: LoRA fine-tuning learning-rate schedules are fixed in advance, need re-tuning per model, task, and adapter configuration, and cannot react to training dynamics.
2cvsJnkOoQ.method: Keeps Muon's normalized update direction fixed and meta-learns only the global step size. A recurrent policy, meta-trained across a distribution of fine-tuning runs, conditions on the observed trajectory and emits bounded adjustments to an interpretable analytic schedule.
2cvsJnkOoQ.key_idea: A meta-trained recurrent policy reads the training trajectory and emits bounded adjustments to an analytic learning-rate schedule while Muon fixes the update direction.
2cvsJnkOoQ.evidence: 64 LoRA fine-tuning problems; meta-trained on models up to 16 layers and transferred one-shot to unseen tasks on models up to 64 layers, such as Qwen3-32B and Qwen3.8-27B.
2cvsJnkOoQ.claimed_gains: Outperforms standard fixed schedules at a strong shared default on 64-78% of problems and is on par with the same schedules with per-task tuned peaks.

sxziwGfXSi.one_liner: Regresses LLM-simulated effect sizes on direct-response effects, replication estimates, and original-replication gaps across 61 psychology effects.
sxziwGfXSi.problem: Validating LLM participant simulations against published effect sizes cannot separate a faithful simulation from one echoing the literature or the model's direct response, because published effects are inflated by publication bias.
sxziwGfXSi.method: For 61 psychology effects with original and large-sample replication estimates, runs text-adapted analogues with four LLMs from three developers (about 43,000 simulated participants) and regresses simulated effect size on the direct-response effect, the replication estimate, and the original-replication gap. Also tests whether a paired comparison of two simulators detects a planted difference.
sxziwGfXSi.key_idea: Decompose simulated effects into model direct-response, replicable-effect, and publication-gap components by regression, using a no-participant-framing run as the direct-response measure.
sxziwGfXSi.evidence: 61 psychology effects, four LLMs from three developers, about 43,000 simulated participants in the main protocol, with two independent transcriptions averaged.
sxziwGfXSi.claimed_gains: not stated; this is an analysis paper whose findings are conditional associations rather than performance gains.

Kn2mPpj3ZO.one_liner: SimPrint spreads an error-correcting owner-identity codeword over binary QA probes for black-box LLM ownership verification.
Kn2mPpj3ZO.problem: Black-box fingerprinting treats ownership verification as detecting registered query-response behaviors, which degrade under fine-tuning, pruning, quantization, merging, and serving-time prompt changes.
Kn2mPpj3ZO.method: SimPrint encodes a private owner identity into an error-correcting codeword distributed over natural binary question-answering probes, implants only the probes that must deviate from the base model through a low-interference batch update, and parses suspect-model responses into bits or erasures to recover the identity.
Kn2mPpj3ZO.key_idea: Recast verification as identity recovery: codeword bits embedded in binary QA probes are decoded from noisy black-box responses, with erasures tolerated.
Kn2mPpj3ZO.evidence: Experiments on three open-weight LLMs in clean and modified settings (fine-tuning, pruning, quantization, model merging, serving-time perturbations), with downstream utility checked.
Kn2mPpj3ZO.claimed_gains: Reports reliable identity recovery, robustness to the listed modifications, and comparable downstream utility, with no numbers stated.

kRxfqXyHFh.one_liner: CoMMat generates crystals in few steps by composition-conditioned inductive moment matching over lattice-normalized Cartesian transport.
kRxfqXyHFh.problem: Diffusion- and flow-based crystal generators need long iterative sampling trajectories, limiting high-throughput generation of large candidate libraries.
kRxfqXyHFh.method: Given a composition, CoMMat obtains a composition-conditioned structural latent, predicts the lattice once, and refines only atomic coordinates with species and lattice fixed. It adapts inductive moment matching to periodic geometry through a lattice-normalized Cartesian transport space with periodic coordinate evaluation in wrapped fractional coordinates.
kRxfqXyHFh.key_idea: Separate composition and lattice prediction from a coordinate-only few-step transport solved by inductive moment matching adapted to periodic geometry.
kRxfqXyHFh.evidence: Benchmarks MP-20, Perov-5, Carbon-24, and MPTS-52 for crystal structure prediction and de novo generation; the abstract is cut off at the results.

efsBsWqXBY.one_liner: P-DORM resets stale optimizer state per parameter tensor in test-time adaptation when gradient alignment with history drops unusually.
efsBsWqXBY.problem: Optimizer gradient history can become stale after distribution shifts and hinder subsequent test-time adaptation.
efsBsWqXBY.method: A lightweight wrapper compares the current gradient with the optimizer's stored historical direction, standardizes each tensor's alignment against its own recent history, and rebuilds the accumulated update history of tensors whose departures exceed parameter-aware thresholds, without reverting parameters or changing the objective or architecture.
efsBsWqXBY.key_idea: Standardize each tensor's gradient-history alignment against its own recent history to detect staleness, then reset only the affected tensors' optimizer state.
efsBsWqXBY.evidence: Experiments across corruption and natural distribution shifts, multiple TTA methods, optimizer families, architectures, and test-stream protocols, plus a proof that raw directional alignment is not comparable across tensors.

yngr3bVtsX.one_liner: UTA debiases class allocation and reweights accumulated class statistics for backpropagation-free test-time adaptation of vision-language models.
yngr3bVtsX.problem: Statistics-based TTA for VLMs suffers prediction-biased accumulation from persistent class-wise preferences and classifier homogenization from additive aggregation that retains class-shared components.
yngr3bVtsX.method: History-Guided Allocation Debiasing regulates class allocation using historical class responses, and Activity-Conditioned Classifier Construction reweights accumulated class states by stream-wide coordinate activity to limit shared-component dominance.
yngr3bVtsX.key_idea: Use historical class responses to correct class allocation and weight feature coordinates by stream-wide activity when building the classifier from class statistics.
yngr3bVtsX.evidence: Experiments across multiple settings; the abstract is cut off at 'preserving 95% of ...' and gives no dataset details.
yngr3bVtsX.claimed_gains: The abstract claims strong adaptation performance across multiple settings while preserving 95% of a quantity cut off in the text, with no other numbers stated.

7py5YF0UKi.one_liner: VAR mines Visual Anchors from high-level vision tokens to guide [CLS] updates for KB-VQA entity retrieval.
7py5YF0UKi.problem: Standard vision encoders underemphasize subtle entity-discriminative cues in the global representation, existing fixes rely on brittle region selection or heavy preprocessing, and binary verification discards the relative visual support among candidates.
7py5YF0UKi.method: VAR mines compact entity-discriminative token subsets (Visual Anchors) from high-level tokens and uses them to guide [CLS] updates through the remaining frozen encoder layers. Per the TL;DR, it also calibrates candidate-level visual support for Top-1 document selection.
7py5YF0UKi.key_idea: Fine-grained entity-discriminative semantics persist in high-level tokens, and selected anchor tokens steer the [CLS] representation through frozen layers.
7py5YF0UKi.evidence: Entity retrieval for KB-VQA; the abstract is cut off before experiments, so datasets and models are not stated.

XXaQpjVriy.one_liner: Brief multi-token self-assessment and asymmetric reinforcement rewards teach language models when to invoke chain-of-thought reasoning.
XXaQpjVriy.problem: Uniform deliberation wastes computation, while single-token adaptive gates create information bottlenecks and may depend on expensive external difficulty labels.
XXaQpjVriy.method: MetaThink generates a short natural-language self-assessment before deciding whether to use chain-of-thought reasoning. Reinforcement learning gives higher rewards to correct non-CoT responses so the model learns the decision without external difficulty annotations.
XXaQpjVriy.key_idea: Train a multi-token self-assessment gate using rewards that favor correct answers without chain-of-thought reasoning.
XXaQpjVriy.evidence: Mathematical reasoning experiments compare accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs with adaptive reasoning methods across multiple model scales.

guzrnajUhL.one_liner: Caption-conditioned joint sampling produces video, mixed audio, and separate source waveforms from one audio-video model.
guzrnajUhL.problem: Joint audio-video generators output mixed soundtracks whose individual sources cannot be accessed separately.
guzrnajUhL.method: SepGen extends a pretrained audio-video generator to jointly emit video, the soundtrack mix, and one waveform per captioned source. For separation, it keeps the input mix clean and uses free-text captions to specify the sources to extract.
guzrnajUhL.key_idea: Represent captioned sources as separate waveform outputs within one joint audio-video sampling process.
guzrnajUhL.evidence: Evaluation covers text-generated scenes, scenes rendered by other generators, and real speech, music, and sound-effect recordings.
guzrnajUhL.claimed_gains: Given an audio mix and captions carrying the spoken lines, SepGen outperforms language-conditioned separators on caption-based metrics in five out of six separation benchmarks.

K0mylRbzZF.one_liner: Linguistic anchors and hierarchical semantic control redirect forgotten visual concepts toward specified semantic ancestors.
K0mylRbzZF.problem: Vision-language unlearning can leave recognition intact across visual domains or alternative queries and disrupt neighboring concepts.
K0mylRbzZF.method: CSOA defines linguistic neighborhoods through a quadrant anchor system and guides edited representations toward user-specified semantic ancestors. Knowledge-matched controls and factorial interventions assess semantic redirection and the retention-focused CSOA-R variant.
K0mylRbzZF.key_idea: Constrain concept-selective representation edits with linguistic anchors and hierarchical guidance toward chosen semantic ancestors.
K0mylRbzZF.evidence: Tests cover three CLIP backbones and 40 additional concepts, with paired generative comparisons separating recognition suppression from answer disclosure.

z7f4exadqr.one_liner: Epistemic-operation parsing and symbolic dependency tracking verify conversational claims and propagate retractions in linear time.
z7f4exadqr.problem: Language models can continue conversations using premises that earlier turns have already abandoned.
z7f4exadqr.method: An LLM Interpreter converts utterances into epistemic operations, which a symbolic engine applies to a claim-dependency map. Map traversal verifies continuations without another LLM call and propagates retractions to exactly the conclusions that lose support.
z7f4exadqr.key_idea: Track claim dependencies and epistemic updates symbolically so grounding checks and support retractions reduce to dependency-map traversal.
z7f4exadqr.evidence: Experiments with five QA models use ReviseQA and MemoryAgentBench FactConsolidation, including raw-text update extraction by a GPT-4o Interpreter.
z7f4exadqr.claimed_gains: The verifier raises MemAB-FC single-hop accuracy from 0.46–0.95 to 0.94–0.98, while QA prompts use 97–174 tokens versus 114.5K for the full-context baseline.

ZV2MeCjkLt.one_liner: Validity-gated reinforcement learning and trajectory-based self-distillation train diffusion language models for multi-turn agent tasks.
ZV2MeCjkLt.problem: Multi-turn diffusion agents face invalid actions, failed tool calls, and an accuracy-parallelism tradeoff that coarse KL approximations inadequately address.
ZV2MeCjkLt.method: d3LLM-v2 combines validity-based reward gating with implicit policy regularization during agentic reinforcement learning. Trajectory-based online self-distillation uses the model as its own teacher to improve decoding efficiency.
ZV2MeCjkLt.key_idea: Gate rewards by action validity and use online trajectory self-distillation to train agentic diffusion decoding.

XqhqthjC3r.one_liner: Camera-ray coordinates augment pretrained attention queries and keys to control video diffusion geometry.
XqhqthjC3r.problem: Pixel-time positions identify tensor locations without directly encoding the viewing geometry needed for camera control.
XqhqthjC3r.method: SCoPE adds camera rays to attention queries and keys, introducing a ray-only score term whose raw-ray form recovers the reciprocal product. Normalize-Gate-Inject handles metric and up-to-scale poses while preserving pretrained RoPE and starting from unchanged DiT behavior.
XqhqthjC3r.key_idea: Inject camera-ray positional coordinates into queries and keys so attention includes a geometric ray-to-ray compatibility term.
XqhqthjC3r.evidence: Experiments on Wan2.2 at 5B and 14B evaluate camera controllability, fidelity, and closed-loop revisits.
XqhqthjC3r.claimed_gains: SCoPE adds under 0.1% new parameters; at 14B, rotation error falls 29% and FVD 43% below the strongest baseline.

Qptw6ioPMV.one_liner: Latent label-space reconstruction from unlabeled images extends vision-language prompt tuning beyond available class names.
Qptw6ioPMV.problem: Unsupervised vision-language adaptation assumes complete class vocabularies, biasing adaptation against omitted classes when names are missing.
Qptw6ioPMV.method: The paper defines vocabulary-incomplete unsupervised vision-language adaptation and proposes Label Space Reconstruction. LSR reconstructs a latent label space from unlabeled data and incorporates it into prompt tuning.
Qptw6ioPMV.key_idea: Reconstruct latent classes from unlabeled data and include them in prompt tuning alongside the incomplete named vocabulary.
Qptw6ioPMV.evidence: The paper derives an omitted-class semantic discrepancy bound and reports experiments across eight benchmarks.

gohXxOLjub.one_liner: Debiasing per-point values before exact KNN-Shapley recursion separates recommendation data value from unequal exposure.
gohXxOLjub.problem: Missing-not-at-random exposure makes frequently shown items appear valuable and systematically undervalues low-exposure interactions in naive Shapley valuation.
gohXxOLjub.method: SHADE corrects per-point values with debiased and doubly robust estimates before applying the closed-form KNN-Shapley recursion. The correction also assigns value to unexposed items for downstream augmentation and collection.
gohXxOLjub.key_idea: Apply debiased and doubly robust per-point estimates inside exact KNN-Shapley valuation to remove exposure-driven credit shifts.
gohXxOLjub.evidence: Formal analysis characterizes exposure-induced ranking reversals, and synthetic MNAR plus real recommendation experiments test long-tail valuation and recovery toward oracle rankings.

JL6UpZeewX.one_liner: Gradient-based endpoint probes isolate negative updates throughout training to distinguish algorithm- and phase-dependent learning roles.
JL6UpZeewX.problem: Single-update analyses and negative-only experiments do not explain negative learning's role across trajectories with composite objectives.
JL6UpZeewX.method: The paper probes negative updates separately throughout training using a gradient-based endpoint framework. Its findings motivate stage-aware methods that modulate negative-learning strength, with implementation details truncated in the supplied abstract.
JL6UpZeewX.key_idea: Probe negative-update gradients against endpoints across training phases to separate regularization, target shaping, and offsets to positive learning.
JL6UpZeewX.evidence: Analyses find early regularization and later out-of-distribution target shaping in off-policy DPO, while PPO and GRPO negative updates offset endpoint-aligned positive learning without stable target shaping.

7UIyUgjzd7.one_liner: Comparing Bayesian and radial filters shows that diverging internal updates can coexist with vanishing predictive KL.
7UIyUgjzd7.problem: An internal update gap alone may not establish predictive failure because state occurrence and decoder sensitivity mediate predictive cost.
7UIyUgjzd7.method: The study constructs exact Bayesian mixing and a deterministic radial filter on the same belief coordinates in a stationary symmetric Gaussian HMM. It analyzes worst-case centered-logit separation and posterior KL using confidence cones, softmax curvature, and noise control.
7UIyUgjzd7.key_idea: Construct divergent belief updates whose outputs occupy a shared confidence cone where softmax curvature suppresses predictive disagreement.
7UIyUgjzd7.evidence: Proofs cover every fixed finite K≥2 and stationary trajectories, with Gaussian sweeps for K in {2,4,8} and long-horizon binary recurrence controls.

OAl2SI5C8A.one_liner: Validity-preserving graph operations and neural-guided tree search jointly optimize logical routing and switch placement in chip design.
OAl2SI5C8A.problem: Joint routing and switch placement require exploration of enormous design spaces under structural, geometric, and logical constraints.
OAl2SI5C8A.method: A hierarchical reinforcement-learning framework expands a minimal routing graph through switch expansion, switch placement, and route refinement while preserving one loop-free route per communicating pair. Gumbel Monte Carlo Tree Search explores this space, with cross-floorplan pretraining followed by instance fine-tuning.
OAl2SI5C8A.key_idea: Restrict search to feasible routing graphs through validity-preserving expansion, placement, and refinement operations guided by Gumbel Monte Carlo Tree Search.
OAl2SI5C8A.evidence: Experiments compare neural-guided search with non-learning optimization and examine cross-floorplan pretraining for fine-tuning on unseen instances.

Hxdi4f7oMh.one_liner: Solvo allocates tree slots before sampling tokens to preserve target distributions during speculative decoding.
Hxdi4f7oMh.problem: Global pruning can make a sampled token's retention depend on its identity, complicating lossless tree speculative decoding.
Hxdi4f7oMh.method: Solvo commits parent slots using a global path-score threshold before drawing tokens and never reranks those slots afterward. Each non-root candidate group combines top-ranked deterministic tokens with a final sample from the remaining draft mass.
Hxdi4f7oMh.key_idea: Commit candidate slots before sampling so token identity can influence subsequent expansion but cannot determine its own retention.
Hxdi4f7oMh.evidence: A martingale argument over tree growth proves preservation of the exact target-model distribution under adaptive growth.

bwDEyxc3jZ.one_liner: Decision-TabPFN scores perishable inventory orders with a frozen tabular predictor using retailer records.
bwDEyxc3jZ.problem: Perishable inventory decisions must account for stockout-censored sales and unknown demand cycles, while better action scores may not yield better policies.
bwDEyxc3jZ.method: Decision-TabPFN uses a frozen tabular predictor to score candidate orders from inventory, order, and profit records. A horizon-independent bound on starting inventory effects identifies low-regret conditions for direct scoring and supports demand learning with full-horizon planning.
bwDEyxc3jZ.key_idea: Score candidate orders from retailer records with a frozen tabular predictor, and bound inventory's future-value effects to characterize planning requirements.
bwDEyxc3jZ.evidence: Experiments cover eight three-day-shelf-life settings and held-out store-sales simulations, alongside a sublinear regret guarantee for demand learning with full-horizon planning.
bwDEyxc3jZ.claimed_gains: Its 10,000-day mean profit exceeds Thompson sampling, XGBoost forecasting, conventional stock rules, and Meta-HQL across eight settings, with significant Meta-HQL gains in four lost-sales settings after Holm correction, although an informed one-day controller earns more in all eight.

wa0ynlT8C6.one_liner: SanTA verifies language-model-proposed sanitizer conditions against source code before allowing calls to block taint.
wa0ynlT8C6.problem: Fixed sanitizer rules misclassify vulnerabilities when Python sanitization depends on runtime types, control flow, or library versions.
wa0ynlT8C6.method: SanTA uses a language model to identify sanitizer calls and express effectiveness conditions in a closed vocabulary. A symbolic layer checks these hypotheses against source code facts and blocks taint only after establishing every condition and obligation.
wa0ynlT8C6.key_idea: Treat sanitizer effectiveness as explicit hypotheses that a symbolic verifier must establish before a call can block taint.
wa0ynlT8C6.evidence: Evaluations use CVEfixes, a conditional-sanitizer benchmark with verification-layer ablations, and 30 popular real-world Python libraries.
wa0ynlT8C6.claimed_gains: SanTA reports the analyzer roster's best F1 (0.67) and recall (0.83) on CVEfixes and finds 15 previously-unknown vulnerabilities across 30 libraries, 3 with assigned CVE ids.

L17sEWT586.one_liner: OpDecompBench compares automated jailbreak scores with blinded human judgments of usable assistance on identical outputs.
L17sEWT586.problem: Automated jailbreak-success scores may not measure whether model outputs actually provide usable help for forbidden tasks.
L17sEWT586.method: OpDecompBench holds prompts, models, and outputs fixed while comparing automated scores with blinded human assessments of task-linked assistance. It examines score-based triage, evaluator-dependent attack rankings, and two stress tests, with content-free ledgers for recomputation.
L17sEWT586.key_idea: Audit identical model outputs with automated scores and blinded human usability judgments to isolate evaluator-dependent measurement differences.
L17sEWT586.evidence: A prospective audit of every StrongReject-positive pilot output, a large public benchmark, an independent extension, and a stricter judge prompt test the measurement gap.

bWQ0CoYJTm.one_liner: An evaluation reward model assesses time-series tool calls using accumulated evidence to reshape agent actions.
bWQ0CoYJTm.problem: Time-series agents execute low-value tool calls, while post-training their large base models adds computational cost.
bWQ0CoYJTm.method: An evaluation reward model assesses each tool call using accumulated evidence without post-training the base agent. The iterative evaluation and action adjustment form a Markov decision problem whose expected reward combines tool costs with task performance.
bWQ0CoYJTm.key_idea: Use accumulated evidence to reward tool-call decisions within a Markov decision process while leaving the base agent unmodified.

96nnvbhjBH.one_liner: OneFixer refines degraded 3D Gaussian renderings through one-step autoregressive diffusion with flow-matching and perceptual supervision.
96nnvbhjBH.problem: Driving simulation requires temporally consistent, detailed 3D Gaussian renderings at latencies that staged diffusion refinement struggles to meet.
96nnvbhjBH.method: OneFixer adapts an autoregressive video-diffusion model in one stage, using degraded 3DGS renderings as the flow source without teacher-student distillation. Shared rollouts combine latent flow matching on generated history with pixel perceptual gradients through recent predictions, conditioned on lane geometry and agent states.
96nnvbhjBH.key_idea: Supervise one-step refinement from degraded renderings with latent flow matching and perceptual gradients through shared autoregressive rollouts.
96nnvbhjBH.evidence: Tests on Waymo and proprietary driving scenes, including 900-frame Seoul rollouts, report the lowest FVD, LPIPS, and DISTS among one-step baselines.

m10A3vmiIK.one_liner: MuscleSight pairs arm ultrasound with audited video labels to test hand decoding across sessions and participants.
m10A3vmiIK.problem: Ultrasound-based hand decoding evaluations mostly stay within participants and sessions, leaving cross-session and cross-person generalization unclear.
m10A3vmiIK.method: MuscleSight synchronizes arm-mounted B-mode ultrasound with multi-view video to provide audited hand-pose and gesture labels. Its benchmark tests gesture classification, pose regression, and initialized tracking within sessions and on held-out sessions and participants, including few-shot calibration.
m10A3vmiIK.key_idea: Separate within-session performance from held-out-session and participant performance using synchronized ultrasound and audited hand labels.
m10A3vmiIK.evidence: The benchmark contains 37.7 hours from 33 participants across 113 sessions, 37 manual tasks, and interactions with 72 objects.
m10A3vmiIK.claimed_gains: Within sessions, a 0.28 M-parameter CNN reaches 89.5% gesture accuracy against a 21.0% majority baseline, but held-out gesture classifiers fail to beat that baseline and pose regressors improve over a constant mean pose by at most 1.8°.

K13vPKlzLo.one_liner: NativeRefine temporarily relaxes source rays for camera fitting, then refits depth around frozen native geometry.
K13vPKlzLo.problem: Feed-forward 3D geometry and camera predictions do not fit the images of each individual scene.
K13vPKlzLo.method: NativeRefine uses RGB correspondences and bounded source-ray variables to fit cameras without training. It then discards those variables, fixes the cameras, and refits a compact depth field relative to native predictions while exactly preserving geometric mean depth.
K13vPKlzLo.key_idea: Use temporary ray flexibility for camera fitting, then remove it before refitting a compact depth field anchored to native predictions.
K13vPKlzLo.evidence: Evaluations cover four frozen backbones, 600 windows from three benchmarks, known and predicted intrinsics, and two held-out recordings on a single 16 GB GPU.
K13vPKlzLo.claimed_gains: With known intrinsics, joint point and translation errors improve in 10 of 12 settings against both native predictions and bundle adjustment with the same dense refit; held-out translation errors fall by 27.6% for MapAnything and 26.9% for Pi3X, while predicted-intrinsics point error improves in 9 of 12 settings.

upw4YmNJBn.one_liner: FC-JD diffuses mutation masks on a Johnson graph to generate protein sequence batches with exactly K mutations.
upw4YmNJBn.problem: Protein library cloning requires exactly K mutations per sequence, a constraint that post-hoc filtering cannot restore.
upw4YmNJBn.method: FC-JD uses a two-stream diffusion model whose position stream evolves mutation masks on the Johnson graph J(N, K), preserving cardinality by construction. A simulation-free objective replaces forward rollouts with an analytic posterior over reverse transitions.
upw4YmNJBn.key_idea: Constrain mutation-mask diffusion to a Johnson graph so every generated design preserves exactly K mutated positions.
upw4YmNJBn.evidence: A pre-registered oracle-scored benchmark compares four arms across three complete-oracle landscapes, a partial-oracle case study, and a regression-only dataset under matched batch budgets.
upw4YmNJBn.claimed_gains: FC-JD generates exact-K designs every round, delivers batches in under two seconds, and descriptively matches or exceeds GP-BO on the extreme tail in every oracle-evaluable cell at K ∈ {5, 7}, while simulated annealing retains the best mean fitness.

MyFkkVcxbi.one_liner: BAVO learns response-behavior predictors from VLM representations to guide visual jailbreak optimization and adaptively select iterates.
MyFkkVcxbi.problem: Fixed-budget visual jailbreak optimization uses token-level objectives that only indirectly reflect harmful response behavior.
MyFkkVcxbi.method: BAVO trains a lightweight predictor on internal VLM representations to estimate response-level behavior. Its differentiable signal guides image optimization and instance-adaptive iterate selection without generating and evaluating responses at every update.
MyFkkVcxbi.key_idea: Replace indirect token targets with a learned differentiable response-behavior signal that also selects optimization iterates adaptively.
MyFkkVcxbi.evidence: Experiments cover 917 multimodal jailbreak samples, four target VLMs, three defenses, and analysis of refusal, intermediate, and successful responses.
MyFkkVcxbi.claimed_gains: Against affirmative-target PGD, BAVO increases E-ASR by 16.68–33.26 percentage points and HarmBench ASR by 10.25–24.64 points, reduces mean optimization steps from 300 to 32.7–161.2, and yields 1.8×–10.4× optimization-stage wall-clock speedups.

306JwztjhH.one_liner: Pseudo-Influence values agent trajectories through pseudo-label perturbations that estimate their training impact for active learning.
306JwztjhH.problem: Conventional uncertainty scores obscure consequential agent decisions among predictable tokens and cannot capture unpredictable environment observations.
306JwztjhH.method: Active Agentic Learning selects informative training trajectories using Pseudo-Influence, which estimates training impact through pseudo-label perturbation. Its efficient estimator has theoretical guarantees without requiring a convex objective or inverse-Hessian computation.
306JwztjhH.key_idea: Perturb trajectory pseudo-labels to estimate training influence directly rather than using predictive uncertainty to choose annotations.
306JwztjhH.evidence: Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B undergo five acquisition rounds on Terminal-Bench 2.0 and ACEBench-Agent, with comparisons at 16 pre-full-pool evaluation points.
306JwztjhH.claimed_gains: The best Pseudo-Influence variant leads all 16 evaluation points by 1.4--5.3 pass@1 points over the strongest alternative, averaging 3.1 points; adding diversity yields first-round Terminal-Bench 2.0 gains of 4.8 and 5.5 points over random selection.

ZYtfPkxlPD.one_liner: A scheduler conditions joint runtime predictions on completed and elapsed runtimes before minimizing expected remaining workflow cost.
ZYtfPkxlPD.problem: Scheduling from separate task-runtime distributions ignores dependencies that reveal unfinished tasks' runtimes as execution progresses.
ZYtfPkxlPD.method: The scheduler updates a predicted joint runtime distribution using completed runtimes and elapsed execution times, then chooses the action with minimum expected remaining workflow completion cost. Truncated Joint Fitting caps long runtimes while preserving task pairings in historical data.
ZYtfPkxlPD.key_idea: Condition a joint runtime distribution on completion and survival observations so each scheduling decision incorporates inter-task dependence.
ZYtfPkxlPD.evidence: The analysis compares exact schedulers with identical correct marginal predictions but different dependence modeling and bounds excess cost from joint prediction error.
ZYtfPkxlPD.claimed_gains: For fixed model parameters and bounded second moment of total runtime, TJF attains O(h^{-1/n}) expected excess cost for n≥3 under arbitrary runtime dependence.

JnZ7qG4y1j.one_liner: KVScout retrieves KV entries for an entire upcoming sentence and reuses them throughout sentence generation.
JnZ7qG4y1j.problem: Frequent KV selection and transfer erode sparse-attention speedups, while reusing next-token selections over longer spans reduces generation quality.
JnZ7qG4y1j.method: KVScout builds a contextualized sentence index during prefill with a lightweight retriever. Before each sentence, it queries that index with the generation state and reuses the selected KV window throughout the sentence.
JnZ7qG4y1j.key_idea: Learn sentence-level KV selection so each retrieved window supports all decoding steps in the next sentence.
JnZ7qG4y1j.evidence: Three long-context benchmarks test generation quality and throughput with an 8.9M-parameter retriever, including 256K-context comparisons.
JnZ7qG4y1j.claimed_gains: At 256K context, KVScout achieves 5.3× higher throughput than full-cache decoding and 1.7–3.7× higher throughput than existing KV retrieval methods.

zkLx90uwGY.one_liner: FoRM anchors real-image features to a frozen teacher and aligns local directional Jacobians to preserve real-manifold geometry.
zkLx90uwGY.problem: Envelope-based generated-image detection can distort the enclosed real manifold during training, introducing bias despite a well-modeled outer boundary.
zkLx90uwGY.method: FoRM anchors pointwise detector features to a frozen visual foundation model. Local Directional Jacobian Alignment then matches teacher and detector responses and magnitudes along natural image variation directions.
zkLx90uwGY.key_idea: Preserve real-image geometry through pointwise feature anchoring plus teacher-detector alignment of local directional responses and magnitudes.

6Ec8ltjjAk.one_liner: Async-SNN replaces synchronization-heavy transformer operators, converts the model to spiking neurons, and adapts firing budgets to power constraints.
6Ec8ltjjAk.problem: RMSNorm and Softmax Attention impose global dependencies that prevent neuron-level asynchronous execution in spiking LLMs.
6Ec8ltjjAk.method: Async-SNN replaces RMSNorm with Hardtanh Dynamic Normalization and Softmax Attention with Normalized Linear Attention. Calibration, supervised quantization-aware fine-tuning, and ST-BIF conversion produce a spiking model whose greedy adaptive firing reallocates budgets across layers and timesteps.
6Ec8ltjjAk.key_idea: Remove global operator synchronization before ANN-to-SNN conversion, then allocate neuron firing dynamically under instantaneous power constraints.
6Ec8ltjjAk.evidence: Experiments evaluate Async-SNN on 0.6B and 1.7B models.

SeAM7kh7mi.one_liner: MirageBench holds lagged causal edges fixed while varying latent confounding and separately evaluating ranking, selection, lag localization, and error control.
SeAM7kh7mi.problem: Causal-discovery reliability under latent confounding is difficult to assess, and strong pair rankings can hide false discoveries.
SeAM7kh7mi.method: MirageBench varies confounding strength, observed-variable count, record length, and latent complexity without changing lagged-edge ground truth. POLE evaluates pair ranking, operating points, lag localization, and error control separately.
SeAM7kh7mi.key_idea: Keep causal ground truth fixed across confounding interventions and separate output ranking from selected-edge error control.
SeAM7kh7mi.evidence: Controlled multivariate time-series experiments test how confounding, observational resources, latent complexity, and selectors affect rankings and error-control recovery.

xreLSorBR8.one_liner: STAR ranks instruction data by combining alignment in task-shared and target-specific FFN activation subspaces.
xreLSorBR8.problem: Target-focused instruction-data selection can harm other tasks, while symmetric task balancing does not explicitly prioritize the target.
xreLSorBR8.method: STAR uses frozen-LLM FFN activations to identify balanced task-shared neurons and target-preferential neurons. It measures candidate alignment with reference-task and target prototypes in the corresponding subspaces and combines their scores for selection.
xreLSorBR8.key_idea: Combine prototype-alignment scores from task-shared and target-specific neuron subspaces to rank instruction examples.
xreLSorBR8.evidence: Experiments cover five target tasks and four OOD benchmarks under 5% and 1% selection budgets.

vKbQ0Z68KB.one_liner: Fixed-size delta-rule memory states transfer between frozen LLM backbones through reader heads and writer-specific SVD alignment.
vKbQ0Z68KB.problem: Agent memories tied to model-specific interfaces cannot readily survive changes of backbone.
vKbQ0Z68KB.method: A frozen writer encodes episodes into fixed-size per-layer memory matrices, which another frozen backbone reads through a ∼3M-parameter head. Each writer independently normalizes its axes and scale using mean-state SVD so frozen reader heads can read unseen writers.
vKbQ0Z68KB.key_idea: Separate stored delta-rule matrices from model-specific projections and align writer coordinates using mean-state SVD.
vKbQ0Z68KB.evidence: Experiments test five readers from four families (3B–32B), unseen-writer transfer, a universal read head, and retrieval with 121K-token histories.
vKbQ0Z68KB.claimed_gains: Memory alone improves 21 of 25 reader–benchmark pairs, with unseen-writer transfer reported on 16/16 pairs and 44/50 with a single universal head.

6R0d0BAgT8.one_liner: A milestone dependency graph expands and selects strategies for self-evolving LLM agents.
6R0d0BAgT8.problem: Reusing successful experiences can collapse exploration and prevent agents from trying better strategies.
6R0d0BAgT8.method: The approach represents strategy space as a directed acyclic graph of milestones and prerequisite relationships. It expands the graph with evidence-supported unexplored directions and selects between promising known strategies and new ones during planning.
6R0d0BAgT8.key_idea: Maintain a growing milestone dependency graph and explicitly balance known-strategy selection with exploration of untried directions.
6R0d0BAgT8.evidence: The abstract reports baseline comparisons and component ablations across diverse settings without naming benchmarks or models.

UkXSUeUkgR.one_liner: MemForm pairs clean and poisoned memory-formation conditions to isolate five attack interfaces in LLM agents.
UkXSUeUkgR.problem: Existing memory-poisoning studies insufficiently distinguish the interfaces that produce and commit persistent agent memories.
UkXSUeUkgR.method: MemForm defines controlled poisoning interventions for Content, Evidence, Scope, Selection, and Path interfaces. Paired clean and poisoned conditions isolate interface effects, including retention choices and consolidation order.
UkXSUeUkgR.key_idea: Vary memory-formation interfaces under paired controls, isolating retention and consolidation-order effects from the underlying experiences.
UkXSUeUkgR.evidence: Evaluations across six LLMs and two response formats find susceptibility at all five interfaces, including order-dependent behavior with identical retained experiences.

KZNHjq4zvQ.one_liner: Retrieval, constrained beam search, and a bundle-aware critic jointly compose agent backbones, tools, and skills.
KZNHjq4zvQ.problem: Independent resource scoring misses complementarities, while fixed catalogs and reused configurations limit composition for new tasks.
KZNHjq4zvQ.method: The method retrieves resource candidates and configurations from similar tasks, then a fine-tuned generator recombines resource descriptions through constrained beam search. A critic ranks complete bundles using an LLM teacher and successful historical configurations, adapting to execution feedback when available.
KZNHjq4zvQ.key_idea: Generate complete resource bundles from retrieved descriptions and rank their joint utility with a bundle-aware critic.

5THOWpn50c.one_liner: An entropy-tilt characterization identifies when duplicating an agent changes Nash averaging ratings.
5THOWpn50c.problem: The claimed duplicate invariance of Nash averaging can fail when maximum-entropy selection chooses among multiple equilibria.
5THOWpn50c.method: The paper characterizes invariance by comparing a copy-induced linear entropy tilt with entropy loss within the equilibrium set. It identifies which agents can change rating and analyzes discontinuities and relaxed equilibrium selection.
5THOWpn50c.key_idea: Duplication adds an entropy tilt proportional to the copied agent's probability, potentially moving the selected maximum-entropy equilibrium.
5THOWpn50c.evidence: Proofs accompany Atari and chatbot-arena checks and football analysis: forty of the forty-four seasons have multiple equilibria, and seventeen exhibit copy-induced reorderings.

s2HRGnW2Ed.one_liner: GIFT ranks token distillation gradients by reinforcement-learning compatibility and progressively reduces distillation coverage.
s2HRGnW2Ed.problem: Dense teacher imitation can conflict with outcome-based reinforcement learning during reasoning training.
s2HRGnW2Ed.method: GIFT decomposes each token's distillation gradient into components parallel and orthogonal to the RL gradient to score conflict and additional directional guidance. A shrinking coverage budget discards conflicting updates first while retaining complementary updates at full strength.
s2HRGnW2Ed.key_idea: Rank token guidance using parallel and orthogonal gradient components, then anneal the number of distilled tokens.

Pcpk3EHHkr.one_liner: FullSplat completes query-exposed Gaussian scene gaps using object priors, background rectified flow, and observation-preserving gates.
Pcpk3EHHkr.problem: Camera deviations during driving simulation expose poorly reconstructed surfaces and occluded backgrounds absent from recorded observations.
Pcpk3EHHkr.method: FullSplat identifies low-support regions likely to appear under a bounded camera–action distribution. It integrates object-canonical Gaussian residuals from a structured 3D prior and world-fixed background residuals from masked rectified flow using conflict resolution and observation-preserving gates.
Pcpk3EHHkr.key_idea: Use expected query exposure to complete separate object and background Gaussian layers once, then integrate them into a persistent scene.
Pcpk3EHHkr.evidence: Waymo and nuScenes experiments cover reconstruction, novel-view synthesis, rigid-object edits, and 4–6 m camera-offset stress tests beyond the 3 m Waymo range.

7NWxhx8lBv.one_liner: DRIFT disentangles invariant and responsive cell states, then transports only responsive latents with conditional flow matching.
7NWxhx8lBv.problem: Perturbation prediction confounds treatment effects with pre-existing cell variability, while destructive sequencing prevents paired before-and-after measurements.
7NWxhx8lBv.method: A variational encoder uses conditional priors and an information-theoretic constraint to separate invariant and perturbation-responsive latent blocks. Conditional flow matching transports the responsive block using the perturbation and invariant state as conditions.
7NWxhx8lBv.key_idea: Condition flow transport on invariant cell state while restricting transport to the perturbation-responsive latent block.
7NWxhx8lBv.evidence: The abstract reports evaluation across several benchmarks without identifying datasets or quantitative results.

yQ6uyOy3tG.one_liner: R²-WAM replays self-generated robot rollouts after truncating completed tasks and filtering action–observation inconsistencies.
yQ6uyOy3tG.problem: World action models forget earlier robotic tasks during sequential fine-tuning when original training data is unavailable.
yQ6uyOy3tG.method: A world action model regenerates past task rollouts from instructions for replay. An agentic evaluator truncates each rollout at task completion, and a physical-consistency filter removes rollouts whose actions disagree with observations.
yQ6uyOy3tG.key_idea: Rectify generated replay by removing post-completion motion and rejecting physically inconsistent action–observation trajectories.
yQ6uyOy3tG.evidence: Experiments cover the four LIBERO suites and five real-world tasks, comparing against sequential fine-tuning and experience replay.
yQ6uyOy3tG.claimed_gains: R²-WAM reduces forgetting by over 90% relative to sequential fine-tuning.

9W0AEr7iu4.one_liner: CASE edits diffusion cross-attention weights with activation-derived forget and retain subspaces.
9W0AEr7iu4.problem: Fixed text embeddings fail to capture how concepts vary across denoising states, timesteps, and layers.
9W0AEr7iu4.method: CASE collects cross-attention activations during denoising and constructs layer-specific forget and retain subspaces. A retain-constrained linear operator directly edits cross-attention weights without gradient-based fine-tuning or additional inference computation.
9W0AEr7iu4.key_idea: Derive layer-specific concept subspaces from denoising activations and apply a retain-constrained closed-form weight edit.
9W0AEr7iu4.evidence: Experiments compare activation and text bases on held-out prompts, evaluate ten concepts across four categories, test recovery attacks, and jointly unlearn up to 100 artistic styles.
9W0AEr7iu4.claimed_gains: Activation-derived bases achieve approximately five times the recall of text-derived bases on held-out prompts expressing target concepts.

qexgnvGpid.one_liner: SwimBird combines token and embedding prediction to select text-only, vision-only, or interleaved reasoning per query.
qexgnvGpid.problem: Fixed textual or visual reasoning patterns cannot adapt to queries with different visual and logical demands.
qexgnvGpid.method: SwimBird unifies next-token prediction for text and next-embedding prediction for continuous visual thoughts in a hybrid autoregressive model. Reasoning-mode curation produces SwimBird-SFT-92K to train query-dependent mode selection and adaptive latent-token allocation.
qexgnvGpid.key_idea: Train a hybrid autoregressive model on multiple reasoning modes so each query determines the thinking modality and latent-token allocation.
qexgnvGpid.evidence: Experiments cover textual reasoning and visual understanding benchmarks, with comparisons against fixed-pattern approaches; benchmark names are not stated.

LKYaiI96ea.one_liner: NeSCal penalizes predictive divergence between representation-space neighbors during training to support calibration.
LKYaiI96ea.problem: Train-time calibration methods underuse neighborhood structure in learned representations.
LKYaiI96ea.method: NeSCal regularizes the Jensen–Shannon divergence between neighboring samples' predictive distributions. The accompanying analysis links graph smoothing to local confidence variation and propagation of pointwise calibration error, specifying when smoothing can help.
LKYaiI96ea.key_idea: Penalize Jensen–Shannon divergence between predictive distributions of neighboring samples in representation space.
LKYaiI96ea.evidence: The paper derives smoothing bounds and evaluates image and tabular calibration benchmarks, including composition with temperature scaling.
LKYaiI96ea.claimed_gains: After temperature scaling, NeSCal attains the lowest NLL among evaluated train-time methods in seven of the eight image and tabular settings.

R9evbw1lTt.one_liner: REMEDY-RAG verifies workflow gains against no intervention and selects workflows according to the initial evidence state.
R9evbw1lTt.problem: Previously successful RAG workflows can become counterproductive under different evidence conditions.
R9evbw1lTt.method: REMEDY-RAG extracts workflows from past executions, learns evidence-conditioned assignments using paired gains over no intervention, and independently verifies them. An external map selects a verified workflow or abstains from intervention based on initial evidence.
R9evbw1lTt.key_idea: Admit a reused workflow only when its independently verified, evidence-conditioned gain exceeds the no-intervention alternative.
R9evbw1lTt.evidence: Evaluation includes three QA benchmarks for admission effects and five benchmarks with a frozen Qwen3-8B executor, plus Qwen3-32B transfer.
R9evbw1lTt.claimed_gains: Evidence-conditioned admission raises macro F1 from 47.0 to 50.3, while REMEDY-RAG reaches 50.8 macro F1 across five benchmarks using 80.1% less offline adaptation compute than the strongest baseline.

5xrNwUd8y4.one_liner: Mutual-information post-training couples chain-of-thought reasoning to model outputs to restore monitorability.
5xrNwUd8y4.problem: Ordinary post-training can weaken the relationship between a model's reasoning trace and its behavior.
5xrNwUd8y4.method: The paper proposes an unsupervised post-training objective that maximizes mutual information between chain of thought and output. It applies this objective to policies with degraded reasoning traces and to undegraded policies.
5xrNwUd8y4.key_idea: Maximize mutual information between the chain of thought and the final output during a dedicated post-training stage.
5xrNwUd8y4.evidence: Experiments on three model organisms with degraded chain of thought report recovered monitorability, while undegraded policies show improved judged monitorability and more consequential reasoning steps.

ez8Q02Caao.one_liner: MolLingo combines named BRICS fragments, shared agent memory, and docking context for iterative molecular design.
ez8Q02Caao.problem: Molecular design requires structural reasoning and specialized tools that general-purpose LLM reasoning alone does not provide.
ez8Q02Caao.method: BRICS-based Fragment Enumeration uses chemically valid fragments and corpus frequencies to encode connected molecular blocks with SMILES and common chemical names. Chemist, Literature, and Orchestrator agents share memory and use ADMET prediction, docking, and binding retrieval for optimization.
ez8Q02Caao.key_idea: Represent molecules as recurring chemically valid named fragments and coordinate tool-grounded agent optimization through shared memory.
ez8Q02Caao.evidence: Property optimization compares block representations with raw SMILES using GPT-5.4, Claude-4.6-Sonnet, and Gemini-3-Pro, while GPT-5.4 binding experiments assess docking-derived context.
ez8Q02Caao.claimed_gains: Docking-derived structural context increases mean docking-score improvement from 2.4% with direct prompting to 10.4% with GPT-5.4.

gevsvv3yPx.one_liner: A first-order method finds minimax game-stationary points under local inverse-Lipschitz regularity and compact penalty sublevels.
gevsvv3yPx.problem: Existing nonconvex–nonconcave minimax guarantees often impose strong optimality or gradient-field assumptions.
gevsvv3yPx.method: The paper develops a first-order method under local inverse-Lipschitz regularity around approximate max-player stationary points and compactness of a penalty sublevel set. Its assumptions allow inner stationary points that are neither global nor local maxima.
gevsvv3yPx.key_idea: Replace inner-optimality assumptions with local inverse-Lipschitz regularity around max-player stationary points and compactness of a penalty sublevel set.
gevsvv3yPx.evidence: The theory establishes a stationarity complexity guarantee and sufficient regularity conditions, including uniform nonsingularity of the maximization-variable Hessian at unconstrained stationary points.
gevsvv3yPx.claimed_gains: The method finds an ε-stationary point within \(\widetilde{\mathcal O}({\varepsilon}^{-2})\) first-order iterations under the stated local regularity and compactness conditions.

Vd7ssRqZxi.one_liner: MemoWM stores task-relevant information beyond a shared world model's predictions and reconstructs predictable content at recall.
Vd7ssRqZxi.problem: Long-term agents accumulate storage costs by retaining experience details that a world model could reconstruct.
Vd7ssRqZxi.method: MemoWM conditions memory allocation on a world model available during both storage and recall. Its task-aware rule balances storage cost against the expected downstream impact of reconstruction errors.
Vd7ssRqZxi.key_idea: Retain experience-specific information only when its downstream value exceeds what a shared predictive world model can reconstruct.
Vd7ssRqZxi.evidence: Experiments span five long-term agent-memory benchmarks and analyze world-model strength and total storage including model parameters.
Vd7ssRqZxi.claimed_gains: MemoWM achieves 42.42% average answer accuracy, exceeds the strongest baseline by 2.62 percentage points, and reduces average experience-specific storage by 53.9% relative to MIRIX.

ALQp2LInUs.one_liner: A late-concentrated power-law schedule delays vision-transformer token removal to reduce error amplification under distribution shift.
ALQp2LInUs.problem: Token-reduced vision transformers lose more accuracy relative to uncompressed models under distribution shift.
ALQp2LInUs.method: The paper introduces a training-free, one-parameter power-law schedule that concentrates token reduction in later layers at matched compute. Single-layer and structured merge-error probes examine how early reduction errors amplify downstream.
ALQp2LInUs.key_idea: Delay token reduction toward later transformer layers using a one-parameter power-law schedule at matched GFLOPs.
ALQp2LInUs.evidence: Experiments cover ImageNet-C, five token-reduction methods, nine backbones, and eight additional shift suites, with probes of reduction-error propagation.
ALQp2LInUs.claimed_gains: On ImageNet-C with DeiT-S, late reduction closes 83% of the accuracy gap at 26% compute reduction (+1.17pp) and 99% at 7% reduction (+0.26pp).

KmPvrs2Xvv.one_liner: RUV audits intermediate representation changes with retained controls and permutation calibration to detect deceptive unlearning outputs.
KmPvrs2Xvv.problem: Providers can fool output-based unlearning verifiers by changing responses without removing internal training-data influence.
KmPvrs2Xvv.method: Output-Level Deceptive Response demonstrates output conformity without representation change. RUV instead compares original and unlearned intermediate representations through activation reorganization, displacement, neighborhood disruption, and manifold-support loss, using matched retained controls and joint permutation calibration.
KmPvrs2Xvv.key_idea: Combine four representation-change views with retained-data controls and joint permutation calibration to audit internal unlearning.
KmPvrs2Xvv.evidence: Experiments span exact and approximate unlearning, class- and sample-level requests, multiple datasets, and diverse architectures.
KmPvrs2Xvv.claimed_gains: The abstract reports mean ODR deception success rates of 97.0% and 97.7%.

XeFlm1s3mS.one_liner: DualFuture corrects frozen VLA actions at critical events using discrepancies between success-conditioned and action-induced future predictions.
XeFlm1s3mS.problem: Action-chunked VLA policies accumulate uncorrected prediction errors before observing the consequences of executed commands.
XeFlm1s3mS.method: At persistent gripper transitions, DualFuture predicts a task-success future and a proposed-action future, then decodes their discrepancy into a bounded action residual. Realized rollout futures and known action differences supervise the added components without manual correction labels or backbone fine-tuning.
XeFlm1s3mS.key_idea: At detected action events, decode the difference between two predicted futures into a bounded pre-execution action correction.
XeFlm1s3mS.evidence: Experiments evaluate RoboCasa365 atomic and unseen composite tasks and five tabletop tasks on a real Franka robot with randomized object placements.
XeFlm1s3mS.claimed_gains: Success rises from 73.8% to 78.7% on atomic tasks, from 45.4% to 50.9% on unseen composite tasks, and from 40.0% to 52.0% on real-robot tasks.

qT1Thc0dst.one_liner: Stride routes infographic revisions by scale and accepts only verifier-improving candidates from multiple planned edits.
qT1Thc0dst.problem: Local image edits cannot fix global composition errors, while full regeneration can damage correct regions.
qT1Thc0dst.method: Stride separates constraint evaluation from visual localization, then routes global revisions to a composer and local fixes to a retoucher. Each subagent plans and proposes multiple candidates, and a history-aware evolution strategy accepts only verifier-score improvements.
qT1Thc0dst.key_idea: Route grounded constraint violations to global or local editors, generate redundant candidates, and enforce monotonic verifier-score acceptance.
qT1Thc0dst.evidence: On BizGenEval, open-weight generator–verifier systems using Stride outperform Nano-Banana-2.0 and Seedream-5.0-Pro according to the abstract.

qJva6TNVOW.one_liner: VLAs-as-Tools combines high-level VLM planning with specialized VLA tools that report progress for event-triggered replanning.
qJva6TNVOW.problem: Long-horizon robotic tasks overload standalone VLA policies with both extended planning and diverse physical operations.
qJva6TNVOW.method: A VLM agent selects bounded VLA tools through an interface that reports execution progress and triggers replanning when needed. Tool-Aligned Post-Training uses invocation-aligned examples and tool-family residual adapters to specialize the tools.
qJva6TNVOW.key_idea: Expose specialized VLA policies as selectable tools with execution feedback, trained to follow invocations through residual adapters.
qJva6TNVOW.evidence: Experiments cover five simulated benchmarks using pi_0.5 and three real-world Franka tasks.
qJva6TNVOW.claimed_gains: VLAs-as-Tools improves pi_0.5 success by 8.9 percentage points on average, increases Non-biased Rate by 15.0 points, and raises real-world success from 16.7% to 58.3%.

sXER4OV0rW.one_liner: Language-critique imitation learning converts task-progress and corrective language labels into differentiable supervision for policies.
sXER4OV0rW.problem: Scalar supervision from suboptimal demonstrations ranks behavior without explaining task stage, errors, or corrections.
sXER4OV0rW.method: Language labels from humans, VLMs, or a structured generator describe progress, action optimality, and movement guidance. A differentiable LC-loss incorporates these labels into behavior cloning and diffusion-policy learning from expert and suboptimal demonstrations.
sXER4OV0rW.key_idea: Use a differentiable language-critique loss to guide policy optimization with descriptions of progress, optimality, and corrective movement.
sXER4OV0rW.evidence: The paper proves an expert-performance-gap upper bound under standard assumptions and tests seven continuous-control tasks in navigation, driving, and manipulation, including noisy expert selection.
sXER4OV0rW.claimed_gains: LC-BC and LC-DP improve average success by 8.2% (BC) and 4.3% (DP).

s6CctYLqgb.one_liner: AdaVSkip learns independent attention and MLP routers that skip visual-token computation according to each input.
s6CctYLqgb.problem: Fixed-layer skipping misses input-dependent differences in visual-token redundancy between attention and MLP modules.
s6CctYLqgb.method: Each transformer layer receives two lightweight routers that independently control visual-token participation in attention and MLP computation while the backbone stays frozen. Necessity-score supervision and language modeling initialize routing, then reinforcement learning uses answers from complete sampled paths to refine it.
s6CctYLqgb.key_idea: Independently route visual tokens through each layer's attention and MLP modules, then optimize entire routing paths using answer feedback.
s6CctYLqgb.evidence: The abstract reports input- and module-dependent redundancy observations but provides no named evaluation settings or results.

faG2XrnqSB.one_liner: AllocEmbed learns frame-wise resolutions from previews to distribute a fixed video embedding budget across more frames.
faG2XrnqSB.problem: Fixed frame sampling limits temporal coverage and ignores which frames need spatial detail for retrieval.
faG2XrnqSB.method: A lightweight allocator uses low-cost previews to assign resolutions before an unchanged video embedding backbone. Retrieval-Driven Policy Optimization trains allocation through a rank-validated similarity gap and confidence-guided efficiency incentive.
faG2XrnqSB.key_idea: Allocate per-frame resolution before embedding, using retrieval feedback to balance temporal coverage and spatial detail within a fixed budget.
faG2XrnqSB.evidence: Experiments evaluate MMEB-V2 V-QA and V-RET tasks and the LongRet benchmark, alongside fixed-budget analyses of temporal coverage and resolution.

B7GOxHa8SD.one_liner: S2D-Splat reconstructs static geometry first and conditions dynamic Gaussian reconstruction on cached layer-wise static features.
B7GOxHa8SD.problem: Shared static and dynamic features let moving objects interfere with camera estimation and static scene reconstruction.
B7GOxHa8SD.method: S2D-Splat separates static and dynamic features before estimating cameras and geometry, then supplies cached static features as fixed layer-wise conditions to the dynamic branch. An instance-level motion decoder estimates trajectories for motion-aligned Gaussian fusion and temporal interpolation.
B7GOxHa8SD.key_idea: Use asymmetric layer-wise conditioning from a completed static branch to reconstruct dynamic Gaussians without altering static representations.
B7GOxHa8SD.evidence: Experiments include Waymo reconstruction and zero-shot evaluation on nuScenes and the MM-AU accident dataset.

HTEhYz2IVi.one_liner: Constrained visual-answer protocols convert generated images into scored spatial predictions alongside text-output vision-language models.
HTEhYz2IVi.problem: Text and coordinate answer interfaces hinder comparable evaluation of image-generation models on spatial tasks.
HTEhYz2IVi.method: ProVisE elicits protocol-constrained visual answers, parses them into structured predictions, and uses agentic construction and validation to extend executable protocols to other benchmarks. SpatialGen-Bench supplies a diagnostic spatial task collection.
HTEhYz2IVi.key_idea: Constrain generated visual answers with executable generation-parser protocols that map pixels into task-specific predictions.
HTEhYz2IVi.evidence: Evaluation uses 470 SpatialGen-Bench samples across 14 spatial subtasks and four capability levels, with protocol-construction validation on six external benchmarks.

zbQYakSSV7.one_liner: Token-level rejection tests assign unit importance weights to accepted off-policy tokens while retaining corrections for rejected tokens.
zbQYakSSV7.problem: Compounding token-level importance ratios over long off-policy sequences causes high-variance RL updates.
zbQYakSSV7.method: Selective Importance Sampling treats the off-policy model as a proposal distribution and applies token-level rejection tests. Accepted tokens receive unit importance scores, while rejected tokens keep standard importance corrections in the policy loss.
zbQYakSSV7.key_idea: Apply rejection sampling per token to choose between unit importance weights and standard off-policy corrections.
zbQYakSSV7.evidence: The paper proves a reduced gap between token-level and sequence-level gradient estimators and evaluates dense and MoE models on math and agent benchmarks.

3rRLnNk2BP.one_liner: Stagewise hidden-feature differences supply recurrent momentum states for speculative token drafting.
3rRLnNk2BP.problem: Static target-model hidden features leave lightweight drafters to infer representation transformations, especially for farther-ahead predictions.
3rRLnNk2BP.method: RELAY splits target-model features into low, middle, and top stages and converts their differences into early and late momentum states. An Attention-MLP architecture recurrently refines and propagates these states across draft steps.
3rRLnNk2BP.key_idea: Convert target-stage hidden-feature differences into momentum states and recurrently propagate them during speculative drafting.
3rRLnNk2BP.evidence: Experiments cover multiple backbones, benchmarks, and serving settings, without naming them in the supplied abstract.
3rRLnNk2BP.claimed_gains: RELAY achieves up to 31.3% higher speedup.

jMZu3JiChz.one_liner: Sparse local prototype compositions and autoregressive dynamics pretrain transferable representations of mmWave human point clouds.
jMZu3JiChz.problem: Sparse detections and multipath effects make mmWave human observations unstable for existing point-cloud pretraining methods.
jMZu3JiChz.method: PT³ represents spatially local states as sparse compositions of shared prototypes and predicts their temporal evolution autoregressively. An observation-consistency objective stabilizes representations under radar perturbations before a frozen encoder transfers to downstream tasks.
jMZu3JiChz.key_idea: Represent local radar states with shared sparse prototypes, predict their temporal evolution, and enforce consistency under observation perturbations.
jMZu3JiChz.evidence: After multi-source unlabeled pretraining, a frozen encoder supports action classification, dense point generation, joint pose estimation, and future motion prediction on held-out datasets.

UL6sPWpM1z.one_liner: Locally conserved bounded densities shape realizable draft-selection distributions for lossless multi-path speculative decoding.
UL6sPWpM1z.problem: Selecting one path from multiple drafts changes the verifier's proposal distribution, so selector design determines achievable decoding efficiency.
UL6sPWpM1z.method: Sequential Martingale Selection represents proposal reweighting through locally conserved bounded densities and realizes it with an explicit sequential selector. SMS-LP1 optimizes retained flow online without additional target-model evaluations.
UL6sPWpM1z.key_idea: Optimize retained proposal mass using locally conserved bounded densities that an explicit sequential selector can realize.
UL6sPWpM1z.evidence: LLM decoding experiments compare tokenwise verification and GBV and assess gains with DFlash2 and DSpark.
UL6sPWpM1z.claimed_gains: SMS-LP1 improves average throughput by 18.5% over tokenwise verification and 13.4% over GBV, with a 5.9% average gain on DFlash2 and DSpark.

WuEqBhA71E.one_liner: Surface-aware actuator tokens encode collision geometry and closing rates for grip-force control across virtual hand morphologies.
WuEqBhA71E.problem: Kinematic-only hand representations overlook collision-surface differences that affect grasp retention and grip-force tracking across hands.
WuEqBhA71E.method: DittoHand represents each actuator with a token describing its moving collision surface and the surface's closing rate toward the object. A single grasping policy uses these tokens to transfer actions across VR avatar hands.
WuEqBhA71E.key_idea: Encode each actuator's collision surface and object-approach rate so its action has consistent geometric meaning across hands.
WuEqBhA71E.evidence: Training uses 24 MANO hands; evaluations include 648 unseen hands, 20 objects with 17 unseen, non-MANO hands, and a 12-participant VR study.

ej4ne25ZzJ.one_liner: Structured experience bindings adapt the timing, form, and strength of memory influence during agent execution.
ej4ne25ZzJ.problem: Experience-based self-evolution studies what to learn and retrieve but leaves how experience should influence ongoing execution underexplored.
ej4ne25ZzJ.method: Adaptive Experience Binding learns structured, revisable Binding Experiences from execution evidence and updates them over time. It uses the current execution state to determine how strongly and in what form each experience should guide behavior.
ej4ne25ZzJ.key_idea: Represent execution experience as revisable bindings and adapt their form and strength to the current execution state.
ej4ne25ZzJ.evidence: Measurement studies examine how different applications of the same experience affect agent behavior and end-to-end performance.

4Xu4JX8J5B.one_liner: Distance to a weighted semantic center ranks candidate answers for training-free best-of-N selection.
4Xu4JX8J5B.problem: Voting and token-likelihood scores can miss correct minority answers when surface agreement fails to capture semantic consistency.
4Xu4JX8J5B.method: Radial Consensus Score computes a weighted Frechet mean of answer embeddings and ranks candidates by radial distance to that center. Flexible weighting schemes incorporate signals such as semantic agreement or model confidence.
4Xu4JX8J5B.key_idea: Rank answer embeddings by distance to their weighted Frechet mean, with weights controlling the semantic center.
4Xu4JX8J5B.evidence: The abstract reports experiments across five open-weight models and multiple unnamed benchmarks, but truncates their results.

g5WNVyfn2Z.one_liner: Power iteration and manifold retraction align MoE router rows with their experts' principal singular directions.
g5WNVyfn2Z.problem: Existing MoE routers lack an explicit design rule ensuring each router row summarizes its associated expert matrix.
g5WNVyfn2Z.method: Manifold Power Iteration uses a power step to steer each router row toward its expert's principal singular direction. A retraction step enforces a norm constraint during optimization.
g5WNVyfn2Z.key_idea: Alternate power iteration toward expert principal singular directions with norm-constrained retraction of router weights.
g5WNVyfn2Z.evidence: The paper provides convergence analysis and pretrains MoE models ranging from 1B to 11B parameters.

XXmuTLinUV.one_liner: Discrete motion-token chains receive reinforcement from predicted futures that match observed human and robot video transitions.
XXmuTLinUV.problem: Robot demonstration coverage limits VLA generalization, while scalable human videos lack explicit action grounding.
XXmuTLinUV.method: ThinkWorld represents action thoughts as Chains-of-Dynamics, discrete motion-token sequences connecting current and future states across embodiments. After initialization with labeled demonstrations, it predicts each chain's future and reinforces chains whose predictions match observed outcomes.
XXmuTLinUV.key_idea: Reinforce motion-token reasoning chains according to how well their imagined futures match observed state transitions.
XXmuTLinUV.evidence: Simulation and real-robot experiments assess human-to-robot transfer and generalization to unseen tasks and environments.

WEW6mb7UVd.one_liner: Missingness-interface probes distinguish access to imputed values from learned use, guiding repair-aware continued pretraining.
WEW6mb7UVd.problem: Better imputation need not improve forecasting because missingness interfaces can block fill content or models may fail to use it.
WEW6mb7UVd.method: The study derives an interface bound and probes how fills and observation indicators affect forecasting checkpoints. Its retrofit passes fills with observation flags and trains across gap mechanisms and repair qualities.
WEW6mb7UVd.key_idea: Preserve imputed values alongside observation flags and train explicitly across missingness patterns and repair qualities.
WEW6mb7UVd.evidence: The study probes eighteen checkpoints from eleven families, conducts paired pretraining experiments, and evaluates a retrofit on nine GIFT-Eval subsets.
WEW6mb7UVd.claimed_gains: After 5,000 continued-pretraining steps, the retrofit lowers median MASE by up to 18% in high-missingness windows.

MocJWogwGi.one_liner: Expression-diverse reference galleries support identity evaluation and condition video generation across changing facial expressions.
MocJWogwGi.problem: A single reference portrait underdetermines identity-specific appearance changes and can distort identity-similarity evaluation under strong expressions.
MocJWogwGi.method: The approach builds compact reference galleries spanning expression-dependent facial configurations and measures similarity by expression intensity. It extends Stand-In to condition on these galleries and curates consistent, expression-diverse face crops from training videos.
MocJWogwGi.key_idea: Use expression-diverse reference galleries for both identity matching and conditioning identity-preserving video generation.
MocJWogwGi.evidence: Controlled photographs and MEAD videos quantify how face-recognition similarity varies with expression intensity.

nRbWCPPe9f.one_liner: Filtering unreliable environments and adding process-level behavior rewards shapes terminal agents' compositional decision-making.
nRbWCPPe9f.problem: Synthetic terminal environments can generalize poorly, while reward quality and the behavioral mechanisms behind RL gains remain underexplored.
nRbWCPPe9f.method: The paper proposes that RL shapes high-level routing and composition of previously acquired skills. River filters low-quality environments and augments outcome rewards with process-level behavior signals.
nRbWCPPe9f.key_idea: Filter unreliable training environments and supplement outcome rewards with process-level behavior supervision.
nRbWCPPe9f.evidence: The supplied abstract cites empirical support for the compositional-generalization hypothesis but does not identify evaluation datasets, models, or results.

FwbyaDWCrh.one_liner: Contrasting corrected and erroneous regions assigns visual credit, while target distillation supervises omitted objects in multimodal RL.
FwbyaDWCrh.problem: Response-level rewards can reinforce incorrect regional selections and provide no explicit targets for objects omitted from sampled responses.
FwbyaDWCrh.method: MoVE contrasts corrected and error-preserving regional conditions to refine credit within a response and distills corrected targets for missing objects. It extends GRPO, DAPO, and OPD while leaving inference dependent only on the original image and query.
FwbyaDWCrh.key_idea: Contrast corrected and erroneous regional conditions for credit assignment, then distill corrected targets for objects absent from sampled responses.
FwbyaDWCrh.evidence: Experiments span five grounding benchmarks at 2B and 4B, three model families for corrected-region training, and an extension to visual question answering.
FwbyaDWCrh.claimed_gains: With Qwen3-VL-2B, average Micro-F1 increases from 60.25 to 61.37 over DAPO; the VQA extension reports an 8.7% relative mean-accuracy improvement.

PpOI7Udsps.one_liner: Victim-feedback-guided patch search adapts local image perturbations to attack forgery localization without surrogate models.
PpOI7Udsps.problem: Transfer attacks against image-forgery localization vary across detector pairs because localization evidence depends on both model and input.
